title: 环境与发展 - COP31 ： 专家谈看点与难点
summary: 联合国第三十一届气候峰会已经举办了将近一周，一周来的谈判是否已经使峰会的最终结果初现端倪？峰会有可能在哪些方面取得进展？峰会主席国选择了一个基本上已经达成共识的目标，也就是在2035年将全球终端能源消费的电气化率达到30%。不过，气候行动组织呼吁电气化的电力来源必须是来自绿色能源，也就是所谓的洁净的电气化。那么，来自化石能源的电气化是否也能算是一大进步？此外，峰会上的一些老大难的问题是否依然是谈判的主要障碍？尤其是去年在巴西贝伦峰会上导致欧盟与新兴国家分歧重大的欧盟碳边境调节
content:
联合国第三十一届气候峰会已经举办了将近一周，一周来的谈判是否已经使峰会的最终结果初现端倪？峰会有可能在哪些方面取得进展？峰会主席国选择了一个基本上已经达成共识的目标，也就是在2035年将全球终端能源消费的电气化率达到30%。不过，气候行动组织呼吁电气化的电力来源必须是来自绿色能源，也就是所谓的洁净的电气化。那么，来自化石能源的电气化是否也能算是一大进步？此外，峰会上的一些老大难的问题是否依然是谈判的主要障碍？尤其是去年在巴西贝伦峰会上导致欧盟与新兴国家分歧重大的欧盟碳边境调节机制问题。那么，如何缓解双方之间的分歧？土耳其峰会又有何解药？最后，土耳其峰会在人工智能等领域是否能够取得进展？我们请多年来关注气候峰会的台湾气候行动网络总监赵家伟与英国巴斯大学可持续治理讲席教授孙一先来谈谈他们的看法。

**土耳其峰会与往届峰会有何不同？**

**赵家纬：**这次峰会同以往相对比有三个不同点 ： 第一个主席国是两个，两个国家同时担任主席国这在联合国气候变化框架协议缔约方大会来说还是首次，这是一个新的尝试；第二个不同来讲，就是这次峰会的议题一开始就把它设定得比较明确，就借由三十五的电气化目标，让大家都觉得这是一个正面表述的目标，然后就比较聚焦在电气化的目标。所以我们也看到一些外电形容这次会议它涵盖的议题是它是用narrow这个词，等于说是比较窄的一个状况；由此就引出了第三个特色，不像前几次COP，常常会出现第一周结束还没有确定议程，会议日程在第一天就已经解决了，然后从第二天开始，澳洲主席国就一定要开始就Cover Decesion（封面决定）的一个协调，那也会变成实验室，可能是最早就Cover Decision进行谈判的COP会议。

**法广 ：** 那您觉得这一次峰会除了土耳其提出的在2035年将全球终端能源消费的电气化率达到30%的电气化三十五三十五35%之外，还有可能在哪些方面会有一些突破？.

**赵家纬 ：** 这次峰会最大的一个挑战还是来自去年的这两个路径图 ： 走出化石燃料路线图Transition. Away from Fossil Fuel（_TAFF_）与减少森林砍伐路径图，它们能否正式并列在公约里面去做后续的推动，特别是TAFF路径图这一块，都会跟塑料包装减量工作计划（Waste / Packaging Reduction）减量工作计划的推动能不能够结合在一起？不过，在第一天的时候就已经出现沙特阿拉伯的代表来讲话，不应该将化石能源TAFF路线图纳入NWG （ Non-recyclable Waste Generation），但是我们也看到说有很多国家的事其实是支持这样的做法的，如果真的能够有效的把两者结合在一起，让这个NWG来扮演比较大的效力，然后正式在公约体制里面延续去讨论化石燃料TAF路线图，我会觉得这是这次会议上的一个很重要的看点。第二个讲话当然就是在去年通过的公正转型行动机制也被叫做贝伦行动机制，然后就把它改成是贝伦到安塔利亚机制，今年度如果真的能够把整个机制的设计的细节都能够谈判完成，然后明年能够正式启动的话，那就可以在第二次的全球盘点时，把公正转型议题变成是各国在气候政策上面的必备要素，那这一块也可以算是有所进展。

**无论电力是否来自清洁能源，电气化本身就是一大进步？**

**法广 ：** 说到电气化，确实有许多争议： 气候行动组织要求必须是洁净的电气化，也就是说电力的来源必须是源自可再生能源，另外，核电是不是可以包括在里面也有很大的争议，不过，也有专家认为，电气化本身就是一大进步，不管它的电力来源是什么，你怎么看？.

**赵家纬 ：**对，没错，电气化本身来讲，它的能源效率就是已经可以让它提升，用电动车取代燃油车的话，所消耗的能源至少可以减半，这一个事情我们反而比较不用去担心，所谓的电气化只会让大家对火力机组的依赖和依赖更重，而是因为在整个市场的驱动力之下的话，在全世界九成的地方里面，你要新增加能源的时候，都会是以那个太阳光电是最便宜的选项。那在这样的一个趋势之下的话，你的确去推对终端使用过程中的改变，而改成电气化，那再搭配在供给端这一块整个市场的驱动力的话，它这两个可以相得益彰，那就比较不会出现电气化，没有办法达成减碳功效这样的一个状况。

**安塔利亚****AI承诺为何比贝伦承诺更上一层楼？**

**法广 ：** 您觉得还有什么有必要强调补充的？.

**赵家纬 ：**这次土耳其也会提出一个有关AI的安塔利亚埃承诺。我认为比去年在巴西的时候来得进步。因为去年在巴西的时候在谈AI时都在谈怎么用AI协助减碳，这是在讲说AI对气候这一块有一些正面的帮助，然后去设定一系列的与发展中国家的合作，但这一次是真的要面对AI的用电需求，都要让它能够来自可再生能源。针对AI的用电效率要有多规范，然后以及是要去做相关的资料的揭露，就是AI的一些环境数据的一些揭露，这样的承诺如果真的能够在在这一次峰会上能够获得比较多的国家去支持的时候，那可以去建构一个让各国AI发展操作上面可以去依循的一个规范，所以我还是蛮期待安塔利亚AI宣言可以去发挥它的影响力。

**公正转型机制为何不仅涉及发展中国家而且也涉及发达国家？**

对英国巴斯大学可持续治理奖讲席教授孙一先来说，土耳其峰会是一次落实的峰会。在他看来，此次峰会的一大看点是公正转型机制的落实。他从欧洲的角度分析了为何公正转型不仅涉及到发展中国家，而且也涉及发达国家。

**孙一先 ：** 此次峰会的主题就是落实，就是说，你既然承诺就要落实嘛，所以说实际上具体谈判的话没有那么多，有一个就是去年大家谈成了一个叫Just Transition Mechanism，就是公正转型机制，这个机制具体怎么操作，怎么运行，内部他要有一些什么样的设置，这个今年可能会继续谈这个事，我觉得可能我会比较关注这些，因为我觉得现在大家讨论的这种气候变化转型，它所附带的社会问题也比较多，因为不管是在发展中国家还是发达国家，发展中国家一直就会谈这个所谓的气候正义问题，那你可能有个历史责任问题，但发达国家实际上也存在这个问题，现在欧洲国家都有极右派，事实上也是因为有一些人在这个转型过程中，可能是利益受到损失，那怎么样去做补偿？怎么样能让它公正的持续？否则那实际上就会有倒退（Climate Backlash）。那实际上我觉得就是公正。这个问题是怎么看？那在这个联合国这个C这个机制之下，它是一个怎么样的去去发展？那我觉得这个是我可能会比较关注的一个点。另外的话就是说可能还有一个去年提出来的一个点，当然这个我不觉得一定能谈出一个东西，就是关于贸易有关的，大家可能会关注比较多，特别是从中国的角度，就是贸易壁垒的问题，然后就是贸易和气候，气候行动之间的一个关系，怎么样去有一些设置，但是巴西去年做主席国的时候启动了一个对话机制，然后今年他也会汇报，就是说他开了几次会，虽然这个议题它并不是一个主要议程，我想看一下这个后面往什么方向发展，但实际上很多国家它实际上不愿意把这个问题放在这是联合国气候变化框架公约下谈，因为贸易问题有世界贸易组织WTO，或者别的机制，没有必要放在气候峰会会场去谈。那当然在世界贸易组织这边，它可能也有很多其他的问题，但是就所以说现在就是说联合国气候峰会到底会如何处理贸易问题，今后会往什么方向走，可能还会继续有一些讨论，我可能会关注一下这些问题。

**CBAM贸易关税问题如何化解？**

**法广 ：** 就说到贸易关税问题呀，欧盟碳边境调整机制（Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism _CBAM_）去年在贝伦峰会曾经是谈判的一大障碍，今年，中国、印度以及土耳其这些国家都受到CBAM的影响，CBAM是否继续会成为一大障碍？我非常想听听您个人的意见，其实在这个问题上双方似乎都有理： 欧洲认为如果我一味地依赖中国的电动汽车、太阳能电池板等设施，那么今后整个经济都会依赖中国的技术和产品，所以必须设置关税来保护本地的工业；但是对中国来说，既然必须加速能源转型来应对气候变化，那就不应该设置关税，而是加速推广可再生能源。所以双方似乎都有道理，您既然居住在欧洲，您怎么看？.

**孙一先 ：**确实存在这么一个问题，我们现在面临的气候危机，我们需要加速转型，我们要强化我们的行动，那就需要尽可能快地，广泛地去运用这些技术，但是这些技术不是没有所有权的，谁拥有它，就可能在这里头获利。实际上今天的问题就是说，中国已经在很短时间内建立了一个非常强大的产业链，在清洁能源技术上，实际上包括我们跟中国的一些政策制定者，他们也会觉得，这个确实发展很快。但是其他国家可能会有一些担忧，但是如果拿贸易壁垒来抵御的话，从全球经济贸易治理的规范上来说，它是缺乏依据的，但如果从这些国家的发展角度来说，确实欧洲会很担忧这个问题，但是从现实角度来看，欧洲在短时间之内不可能建起来一个产业链而不再去依赖中国。实际上这里涉及的是一个更深层次的问题，其实欧洲是比较恐惧依赖于中国的，我觉得最根本的还是一个政治上的一种不信任，那这个问题怎么去解决？我觉得这就是一个比较难解的问题。我觉得从两国的政策制定的角度来说，还是要更多的建立这种信任。那如果中国也知道欧洲它确实是担忧经济，那中国可以提供一些投资，怎么样可以帮助到他们，我觉得这个也是要考虑的，就是说分享我们共赢嘛，那我们是要一部分享受我们产品进来的，另一部分怎么样，跟他们做一些合作啊，包括通过合资啊，或者说做一些这种技术上的合作，我觉得也是可以的。所以说就不是一个就是零和博弈，我觉得大家要找到共赢点，这是最重要的。

非常感谢台湾气候行动网络总监赵家纬与英国巴斯大学可持续治理奖讲席教授孙一先接受法王的采访。

title: Long-awaited Hong Kong sex offences reform bill to be gazetted Friday
zh_title: 期待已久的香港性犯罪改革法案将于周五刊宪
summary: 一系列期待已久的性犯罪改革，包括将持续性儿童性虐待和“网络闪光”定为刑事犯罪，已定于本周五在宪报刊登，该法案将于本月晚些时候在立法机关进行审查。由针对妇女的性暴力协会出版的关于性侵犯和性法律改革的小册子。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 《2026年性罪行法例（修订）条例草案》旨在实现两项政策目标，即加强对性罪行受害者的保护，以及使香港有关性罪行的法律现代化，以跟上时代的步伐。
content:
一系列期待已久的性犯罪改革，包括将持续性儿童性虐待和“网络闪光”定为刑事犯罪，已定于本周五在宪报刊登，该法案将于本月晚些时候在立法机关进行审查。由针对妇女的性暴力协会出版的关于性侵犯和性法律改革的小册子。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。保安局在周三的一份声明中表示，《2026年性犯罪法例（修订）条例草案》旨在实现两个政策目标，即加强对性犯罪受害者的保护，以及使香港有关性犯罪的法律与时俱进。报告称，改革旨在审查该市已有数十年历史的性犯罪法律并使其更新，“以解决现行规定的不足之处，并应对与性犯罪有关的社会观念的变化”。 “与时俱进” 该法律草案将于本周五在政府公报上公布，然后于11月25日提交立法会。政府的目标是在明年6月本届任期结束前完成立法工作。该局发言人表示：“我们希望完善香港有关性犯罪的法律，越早越好，加强对性犯罪受害者的保护，同时确保有关性犯罪的法律能够与时俱进。”香港立法会。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
这项立法改革在今年 7 月首次提出时，遭到了要求加强保护的呼声，其中包括缺乏持续的儿童性虐待罪。在这些呼声之后，政府于 9 月提议制定新的罪行，将长期和反复性虐待儿童以及未经同意发送生殖器数码照片（称为“网络闪光”）定为刑事犯罪。作为性犯罪改革的一部分，政府提出了两种新的罪行来代替非礼：涉及触摸的性侵犯和不触摸的性侵犯。它还寻求扩大强奸的范围，以涵盖男性和变性幸存者。与此同时，倡导团体继续呼吁政府对允许性侵犯嫌疑人声称他们错误地认为自己已获得同意的辩护施加限制。

【原文 English Original】
A long-awaited slate of sex crime reforms including the criminalisation of persistent child sexual abuse and “cyberflashing” has been set to be gazetted this Friday, with the bill due for scrutiny at the legislature later this month. Booklets published by Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women on sexual assault and sexual law reform. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Sexual Offences Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2026 “aims to achieve two policy objectives, namely, strengthening protection for victims of sexual offences, and modernising the laws on sexual offences in Hong Kong to keep pace with the times,” the Security Bureau said in a Wednesday statement. The reforms aim to review the city’s decades-old sex crimes laws and bring them up to date, “to address the inadequacies of the current provisions and respond to changes in social perceptions related to sexual offences,” it said. ‘Keep pace with the times’ The draft law will be published in the government gazette this Friday before being introduced to the Legislative Council on November 25. The government aims to complete the legislative exercise before its current term ends in June next year. “We hope to improve the laws on sexual offences in Hong Kong, the earlier the better, to strengthen protection for victims of sexual offences while ensuring that the laws on sexual offences can keep pace with the times,” the bureau’s spokesperson said. Hong Kong Legislative Council. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The legislative revamp was met with calls for stronger protections when it was first put forward this July, including over its lack of a persistent child sexual abuse offence. Following those calls, the government in September proposed creating new offences to criminalise prolonged and repeated sexual abuse against children as well as sending digital pictures of one’s genitals without consent, known as “cyberflashing.” As part of the sex crime reforms, the government has proposed two new offences in place of indecent assault: sexual assault involving touching and sexual assault without touching. It also seeks to expand the scope of rape to cover male and transgender survivors. Meanwhile, advocacy groups have continued to call on the government to impose limits on a defence allowing a sexual assault suspect to claim they mistakenly believed they had been given consent.

title: The Scandal Is Bigger Than Jensen Huang
zh_title: 丑闻比黄仁勋更大
summary: 尽管英伟达的完整故事仍在浮出水面，但最令人震惊的消息可能不是美国最具影响力的人工智能高管黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍有牵连。高级政府官员可能已收到有关危险的警告，但仍继续依赖他来指导美国的技术未来。美国的战略在很大程度上依赖于强大的私营部门参与者，政府不能简单地认为这些参与者的激励措施将符合国家利益。 2025年5月，黄被拍到在T餐厅用餐
content:
尽管英伟达的完整故事仍在浮出水面，但最令人震惊的消息可能不是美国最具影响力的人工智能高管黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍有牵连。高级政府官员可能已收到有关危险的警告，但仍继续依赖他来指导美国的技术未来。美国的战略在很大程度上依赖于强大的私营部门参与者，政府不能简单地认为这些参与者的激励措施将符合国家利益。 2025 年 5 月，黄被拍到与据称是中国国家安全部资产的黄爱丽 (Alice Huang) 在台北用餐，并与黄爱丽有过恋爱关系。今年五月，特朗普总统飞往北京会见中国国家主席习近平。据报道，国务卿马可·卢比奥在飞行中向特朗普通报了这一情报。但这一令人震惊的信息并没有阻止特朗普带黄仁勋出访或将他视为重要顾问。在阿拉斯加加油站，黄与代表团会合。他在通常由总统高级助手占用的小屋里与埃隆·马斯克聊天。黄面前的桌子上放着分发给客人的白宫品牌巧克力：好时之吻。
当一行人抵达北京时，黄从飞机上出来，与特朗普、卢比奥和其他高级官员一起走红地毯，这是黄与总统关系密切以及他对政府的中国和人工智能政策影响力的有力象征。[阅读：经济中心的丑闻]特朗普的本能是支持他的人。这些爆料并没有动摇总统的明显信念，即英伟达的领导人是不可或缺的。但截至撰写本文时，《华尔街日报》报道称，英伟达董事会可能正准备罢免黄仁勋。政府在处理这一问题方面正面临重大质疑：彭博社报道称，2025 年夏末，Nvidia 的总法律顾问就该公司对 Megaspeed 的调查联系了商务部高级官员，而商务部较低级别的员工在如何进行涉及 Nvidia 的调查方面面临着不同寻常的限制。周日，当被问及是否应该按照警告采取行动时，特朗普回答说：“不，我不这么认为。”黄是我们所说的“双鸽子”。他曾说过“对华鹰”标签是“耻辱的徽章”。当美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）主播法里德·扎卡里亚（Fareed Zakaria）问黄仁勋，美国还是中国赢得人工智能竞赛是否重要时，他说：“我认为并不重要。”同样，黄对灾难性人工智能风险的警告不以为然。
这些观点与 Anthropic 的达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 的观点形成鲜明对比，后者是“双鹰”，将中国视为关键的国家安全威胁，并警告人工智能可能对人类构成生存风险。两人都坚称，他们的立场反映了他们对美国国家利益和人工智能未来的理解。但他们的分歧也符合他们的商业利益。英伟达通过向全球尽可能多的客户销售芯片来获利，黄仁勋也曾游说美国限制向中国出售先进人工智能芯片。相比之下，Anthropic 则受益于让中国企业尽可能远离前沿。具有讽刺意味的是，这两个人的生意是交织在一起的。与许多其他领先的人工智能开发商一样，Anthropic 使用 Nvidia 芯片。人工智能竞赛通常被理解为企业之间、国家之间的竞争，

【原文 English Original】
Although the full Nvidia story is still emerging, the most alarming revelation may not be that Jensen Huang, America’s most influential AI executive, was involved with a suspected Chinese spy. It may be that senior administration officials were warned about the danger and nevertheless continued relying on him to guide the United States’ technological future. American strategy has come to depend, to an extraordinary degree, on powerful private-sector actors whose incentives the government cannot simply assume will align with the national interest. In May 2025, Huang was photographed dining in Taipei with Alice Huang, the alleged Chinese Ministry of State Security asset with whom he had a romantic relationship. This past May, President Trump flew to Beijing to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping. In flight, Secretary of State Marco Rubio reportedly briefed Trump on the intelligence. But that shocking information did not stop Trump from bringing Jensen Huang on the trip or treating him as a key adviser. At a refueling stop in Alaska, Huang rendezvoused with the delegation. He chatted with Elon Musk in a cabin usually occupied by the president’s senior aides. On the table in front of Huang sat the White House–branded chocolates given out to guests: Hershey’s Kisses . When the group arrived in Beijing, Huang emerged from the plane to walk the red carpet alongside Trump, Rubio, and other top officials, a powerful symbol of Huang’s closeness to the president and his influence on the administration’s China and AI policy. [ Read: A scandal at the center of the economy ] Trump’s instinct was to stand by his man. The revelations did not shake the president’s apparent conviction that Nvidia’s leader was indispensable. But as of this writing, The Wall Street Journal has reported that the Nvidia board may be preparing to oust Huang. The administration is facing major questions about its handling of the issue: Bloomberg has reported that in late summer 2025, Nvidia’s general counsel contacted senior Commerce Department officials about the company’s investigation into Megaspeed, and lower-level Commerce employees faced unusual restrictions on how they could pursue inquiries involving Nvidia. Asked on Sunday whether he should have acted on the warning, Trump replied, “No, I don’t think so.” Huang is what we might call a “double dove.” He famously said the “China hawk” label was a “badge of shame.” When the CNN anchor Fareed Zakaria asked Huang if it matters whether the United States or China wins the AI race, he said, “I don’t think it does.” Similarly, Huang dismisses warnings about catastrophic AI risks. These views contrast with those of Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, who is a “double hawk,” seeing China as a crucial national-security threat and warning that AI could pose an existential risk to humanity. Both men insist that their positions reflect their understanding of American national interests and AI’s future. But their disagreements also align with their commercial interests. Nvidia profits from selling chips to as many customers globally as it can, and Huang has lobbied against American restrictions on the sale of advanced AI chips to China. By contrast, Anthropic benefits from keeping Chinese firms as far behind the frontier as possible. Ironically, the two men’s businesses are intertwined. Anthropic, like many other leading AI developers, uses Nvidia chips. The AI race is generally understood as a competition among firms and between nations, but it is also a battle of ideas. At its center is what I have called the dream of “ AI primacy ”: the conviction that advanced AI could give the United States a permanent advantage over its rivals, restoring an era of unchallengeable American dominance. But that vision depends on the questionable assumption that technological power accumulated by American companies can be reliably converted into power exercised by the American government. American and Chinese leaders speak of two rival technological systems, but those systems are in fact not entirely separate. They are interdependent, entangled through the movement of technology, capital, information, and people. Beijing has officially refused to import the large quantities of Nvidia chips that the Trump administration has approved for sale—but Megaspeed and similar companies operate on a business model that demonstrates how reliant Chinese AI firms remain on computing power from abroad. Some use data centers in Southeast Asia to get around U.S. restrictions. Silicon Valley executives, for their part, talk of a zero-sum race between America and China even as American AI companies rely on talent from China. These interdependencies create economic opportunities but also avenues for espionage, coercion, and manipulation. And the more the AI race depends on sprawling networks of companies, customers, and governments, the more influence accrues to the handful of individuals who sit at their intersection. [ Rogé Karma: Democrats have no coherent plan for AI ] Technological supremacy and national power do not always pull in the same direction. A remarkably small circle of executives and officials make the decisions that will shape AI’s future and the geopolitical competition around it. The power of these individuals is fast escaping the reach of the institutions responsible for guarding against technological and geopolitical risks. The Information suggests that Alice Huang exploited her access to Jensen Huang to help Chinese companies obtain billions of dollars’ worth of Nvidia chips. Meanwhile, the Commerce Department reportedly delayed action against Megaspeed, even as other agencies pressed for restrictions. Axios reported that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confronted Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick last week about why Megaspeed had not been added to a government list of restricted entities, following months of interagency warnings about the company. The unanswered questions now extend well beyond the affair itself: Did the relationship influence Nvidia’s commercial decisions, causing the company to allocate products to Megaspeed rather than American firms? Did Nvidia’s political influence compromise the government’s ability to enforce its own rules? Some leaders of the AI race speak as though their inventions will allow humanity to transcend its limitations—and perhaps give one country power over all others. Yet the people guiding this transformation remain vulnerable to the oldest weaknesses of human nature: ambition, vanity, fear, greed, desire. The era they are making is defined by the collision between superhuman ambitions and human frailty. The lesson of this scandal is not simply that these people are fallible. It is that we need institutions capable of checking their influence and managing the consequences of their mistakes before these individuals become too powerful to be held accountable. *Illustration image sources: Joel Saget / AFP / Getty; Feng Li / Getty; Finn Gomez / Getty; Sean Gallup/Getty.

title: Jensen Huang now accused of affair with Nvidia executive who reported to him, alleged cover-up attempt
zh_title: 黄仁勋现在被指控与向他汇报的英伟达高管有染，涉嫌掩盖事实

content:
据《纽约时报》报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）已经卷入与一名被美国情报部门认为代表中国从事间谍活动的女性发生婚外情的丑闻。据报道，英伟达董事会现在正准备解雇黄。 《泰晤士报》援引英伟达内部五名匿名消息人士的话称，黄与该公司医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)有关系。消息人士称，黄和鲍威尔于 3 月份在加利福尼亚州圣何塞的一家酒店“亲昵地被拍到”，该公司的 GTC 会议就在那里举行。该报道称，酒店有人用智能手机拍摄了这一时刻，但黄的安全团队“隔离”了他们，并“向该人提出签署保密协议”。鲍威尔于2008年加入英伟达，并一直稳步晋升。 《泰晤士报》强调，Nvidia 的行为准则中提到，个人关系可能会导致利益冲突。和黄一样，她也嫁给了别人。 2018 年，英特尔前首席执行官布莱恩·科再奇 (Brian Krzanich) 因与一名员工发生关系而辞职，这也违反了公司的政策。 Nvidia 尚未回复 Tom's Hardware 的置评请求。如果我们收到回复，这个故事将会更新。
本周早些时候，有消息称詹森与新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的前高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 有婚外情，美国情报部门认为她是间谍。黄在给英伟达员工的电子邮件中承认了这一事件。中国否认了间谍活动的指控。 Nvidia 董事会正在对此事进行调查，由 Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz 律师事务所牵头。在调查正在进行期间，黄将继续经营该公司。律师事务所一直在竞相代表股东起诉该公司，其中包括一项拟议的集体诉讼，指控英伟达在有关该业务的重要事实上误导了投资者。国会众议院中国委员会已呼吁黄进行闭门会议，共和党议员表示这些报告“引发了重大的国家安全担忧”。黄仁勋一直是人工智能行业的领导者，提供该领域最受欢迎的芯片。他还听取了唐纳德·特朗普总统的意见，与他一起旅行并试图影响出口管制。特朗普告诉记者，联邦调查局正在调查黄，但英伟达首席执行官“完全不知道该人是间谍”。

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang — already embroiled in a scandal for an extramarital relationship with a woman believed by U.S. intelligence to be spying on behalf of China — reportedly had a separate affair with one of his direct reports, according to the New York Times . Nvidia's board is now reportedly preparing to fire Huang . The Times , citing five anonymous sources within Nvidia, says that Huang had a relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company's vice president of health care. The sources claim that Huang and Powell were "captured on video being affectionate" in March at a hotel in San Jose, Calif., where the company's GTC conference takes place. That report says that someone at the hotel filmed the moment on their smartphone, but that Huang's security team "sequestered" them and "made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement." Powell joined Nvidia in 2008 and has been steadily promoted. The Times highlights that personal relationships are mentioned as potentially causing conflicts of interest in Nvidia's code of conduct . Like Huang, she is married to someone else. In 2018, former Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigned following a relationship with an employee, which was also against the company's policies. Nvidia has not responded to a request for comment from Tom's Hardware. This story will be updated if we hear back. Earlier this week, it came out that Jensen had an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, formerly a top executive at Singaporean firm Megaspeed and believed by U.S. intelligence to be a spy. Huang admitted to the affair in an email to Nvidia employees. China has denied claims of espionage. Nvidia's board has an ongoing investigation into that affair, led by the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. Huang is continuing to run the company while that investigation is ongoing. Law firms have been racing to sue the company on behalf of shareholders, including a proposed class-action lawsuit that Nvidia misled investors on material facts about the business. The Congressional House committee on China has called on Huang for a closed-door session, with Republican lawmakers saying the reports "raise significant national security concerns." Huang has been a leader of the AI industry, providing the most sought-after chips in the field. He has also had the ear of President Donald Trump, traveling with him and attempting to influence export controls. Trump told reporters that the FBI was investigating Huang, but also that the Nvidia CEO "had absolutely no idea that the person in question was a spy.”

content:
Fundraiser by Yangkey Gangshar : Nepal- Tibet Floods: Help a Mountain Guide's Wife & Children
This fund brings food, housing, and school costs to Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and children
Yangkey Gangshar is organizing this fundraiser.
Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Tamang.
We are Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering, and members of the Gangshar family whose roots are deeply connected to the communities affected by this tragedy. We are raising these funds for our first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and their two young children, who are now facing an unimaginable loss and an uncertain future.
“Cho Cho” is an endearing Tibetan term for an older brother. To our family, Cho Cho Dawa was a beloved husband, father, son, brother, nephew, cousin, and friend.
A Father Who Gave Everything for His Family
At 45 years old, Cho Cho Dawa worked as a mountain guide in Nepal’s Langtang region, providing for his wife and two children. His work often took him away from home for weeks or months at a time, but he took great pride in what he did. He was known for his warmth, kindness, generosity, and joyful spirit.
Tragically, the mountains he knew so well and worked in to support his family became the place where he lost his life.
He leaves behind his wife and two young children—a daughter, 11, and a son, 7. They are now facing not only the devastating loss of their husband and father, but the uncertainty of rebuilding their lives without the person who provided for their family.
The picture attached captures Cho Cho Dawa with his family dressed in our traditional Tibetan attire while celebrating Losar, the Tibetan New Year.
Our Family’s Connection to This Community
Our connection to this region goes back generations.
Our father and his family originally came from Kyidong (Kyirong, སྐྱིད་གྲོང་) in Tibet, a place now often referred to as Gyirong in international news. In 1959, our grandparents and relatives were forced to flee Tibet and eventually found refuge and a new home in the border regions of Nepal.
Our father and his siblings grew up in the Syabru besi and Briddhim communities, where they went to school, formed lifelong friendships, and began rebuilding their lives after leaving Tibet. These communities became an important part of our family’s history and home in Nepal.
The school where our father and his siblings once studied was among the places devastated by the floods.
Yangkey was fortunate to visit Syabru besi and Briddhim in March 2014 and again with Choenyi in November 2025. During those visits, she spent time with Cho Cho Dawa, his wife, mother, and brother and was warmly welcomed into their home. The pictures included here were taken during those visits and are now incredibly meaningful to our family.
The pictures also show places we saw and experienced during our November 2025 visit. One shows a hydropower facility along the road to Syabru besi which has been damanged and another shows the homes, guesthouses, and local businesses in Syabru besi, many of which have since been washed away.
Our family was once forced to leave our homeland in Tibet and found a place in Nepal where generations of our family could rebuild their lives. Now, that same community has been devastated by another unimaginable tragedy.
What took generations to build was swept away in moments. But the lives, memories, and stories connected to these places remain.
Cho Cho Dawa is not the only loss our family is mourning.
His brother, Cho Cho Tsering, is also facing unimaginable grief, as members of his wife’s family were among those tragically swept away.
We are also mourning the many precious lives lost in this devastating tragedy, including relatives, friends, and members of the Tibetan community.
Behind every life lost is a family now facing a future without someone they love.
We are raising funds to directly support Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and two children as they begin rebuilding their lives without him.
The funds will be used specifically for:
Shelter, rent, and household expenses
School-related expenses and future education costs for the children
Medical and other essential family needs that may arise
Long-term support to help the family regain stability and rebuild their lives
100% of the funds raised through this GoFundMe will go directly toward supporting Cho Cho Dawa’s family and, if we are fortunate enough to raise more than is needed for Cho Cho Dawa’s immediate family, additional funds will be used to help other affected families in the Tibetan community of Syabru besi who have lost loved ones, homes, or their livelihoods as a result of this disaster.
Yangkey will be traveling to Nepal in approximately two weeks and plans to personally deliver the funds raised directly to the affected families. The funds will be used solely for the relief, essential needs, and family-support purposes described above.
We want to make sure the support reaches those who need it most and provides meaningful help during this incredibly difficult time.
Every donation, no matter the amount, can make a meaningful difference.
If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your friends, family, coworkers, and community. A share may help this story reach someone who is able to help.
Thank you for taking the time to hear Cho Cho Dawa’s story and for standing with his wife and children, our family, and the communities affected by this devastating tragedy.
From our family to yours, thank you for your kindness, compassion, love, and support.
Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering & Gangshar Family
“The basic foundation of humanity is compassion and love.”

content: Eric Chau   臉書  2026-11-8 香港禁片《消失的檔案》（Vanished Archives）是由香港資深傳媒人羅恩惠執導、歷時四年苦心搜集資料而完成的紀錄片。 這部影片之所以命名為「消失的檔案」，是因為導演當初在香港歷史檔案館搜集「六七暴動」的官方影像紀錄時，驚覺原應長達數百小時的歷史片段，在香港竟然只剩下殘缺不全的21秒。 為了尋回被刻意或無意抹去的歷史真相，羅恩惠遠赴英國國家檔案館翻查解密文件，並親自訪問了大量當年的親歷者。這部紀錄片最終揭露了多項關於1967年香港暴動事件、極具震撼力的內幕消息與歷史黑幕： 紀錄片揭露的四大核心內幕 1. 核心絕密文獻：《吳荻舟日記》與《67筆記》 影片最關鍵的歷史突破，是找到了當年國務院外事辦公室港澳組副組長吳荻舟的私人筆記與檢討材料。 中央高層直接介入： 過去有說法指六七暴動純屬香港左派造反派（如新華社香港分社）自導自演的盲動。但《67筆記》證實，北京中央政府對香港暴亂的每一個細節其實一直知情，甚至不時發出具體指示。 截獲「真槍實彈」： 筆記記載，當時有左派激進分子試圖從內地運送8,400把滅火刀（砍刀）到香港發動武裝暴動。這批物資最終被吳荻舟及時攔截，他因此在文革中遭到迫害。這證實當時暴動確實有演變成全面血腥武裝衝突的奪權計畫。 2. 揭開「少年犯」與「炸彈隊」的真實代價 六七暴動後期發展成無差別的恐怖主義炸彈襲擊，街道上到處都是俗稱「菠蘿」的土製炸彈。 被煽動的愛國學生： 影片訪問了多位當年的左派學校學生（如香島中學、培僑中學等）。他們在文革狂熱的政治宣傳下被煽動組織「炸彈隊」，抱著「反英抗暴」的愛國熱忱上街投擲炸彈、派發傳單。 被拋棄的犧牲品： 這些年輕人在入獄後遭到港英政府的嚴刑拷打，甚至被秘密政治部審訊。然而，當暴動被周恩來叫停、事件平息後，中共高層為了重回外交正軌，迅速與這些基層左派「割席」。這些留有案底的年輕人被港英政府與中共雙方拋棄，政治狂熱退去後，換來的是大半生的坎坷與幻滅。 3. 港共地下黨的權力鬥爭與盲動 紀錄片揭示，這場暴動本質上是中國文化大革命在香港的外延與投影。當時新華社香港分社（實際上的港共地下黨組織）社長梁威林、副社長祁烽等人，為迎合內地文革「造反有理」的風潮，並在外交部奪權鬥爭中表態，不惜在香港無限放大勞資糾紛（新蒲崗人造花廠事件），刻意將其升級為流血政治對抗。 4. 歷史敘事權的爭奪與「改寫」 這部影片最深遠的內幕，莫過於揭露了官方對歷史記憶的系統性清洗。 港英政府的處理： 六七暴動結束後，英國政府將大量極度敏感的政治部（Political Department）檔案、港共滲透名單及審訊紀錄運回英國本土，或直接銷毀，導致香港本地檔案館出現巨大斷層。 特區政府的洗白： 導演指出，近年來特區政府及建制陣營正試圖「重塑」這段歷史，淡化無差別炸彈襲擊對平民造成的傷害，將其重新包裝成「反殖民統治的愛國正義抗爭」。《消失的檔案》則透過血淋淋的受害者證詞（如商業電台林彬被活活燒死、北角小姊弟被炸彈炸死的家屬訪問），還原了這場運動曾演變成無差別恐怖襲擊的史實。 影片的遭遇與社會餘波 由於影片赤裸裸地曝光了中共與港共組織在歷史上的操弄與滲透，《消失的檔案》在2017年完成後遭遇了極大的政治壓力： 官方及商業電影院拒絕放映，香港國際電影節亦以「缺乏藝術性」為由將其拒之門外。 儘管遭受封殺，導演依然在香港社區、學校及海外（美、加、台）進行了數百場獨立放映，引發極大反響，被歷史學者視為還原香港當代史最重要的民間口述紀錄片。 歷史猶如一面鏡子，五十年前內地與香港的政治糾葛，與今日香港的政治變遷有著絲絲入扣的歷史脈絡。羅恩惠導演曾表示，拍攝這部影片不為挑起仇恨，而是為了「守護香港記憶，不讓真相在掌權者的橡皮擦下消失」。

title: Alibaba's Qwen3.8 re-educated with a more Western worldview

content:
美国一家人工智能实验室对阿里巴巴流行的开放权重大语言模型Qwen3.8-27B进行了重新训练，因此该软件忘记了其中国血统。位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀的人工智能实验室 Nous Research 通过培训对该模型进行了再教育，不要与中国的“劳动教养”制度相混淆。在训练后过程的帮助下，Qwen3.8-27B 以 Arete 的名字重生，“以在中国训练的模型上强化西方价值观”。什么是“西方价值观”仍然有待解释。 Nous Research 在一篇博客文章中写道：“开放权重的中国模型是最强大的模型之一，但它们在权重中融入了与国家相关的行为。”记者在本地使用变种型号Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-6bit进行了测试。当被问及 1989 年天安门广场发生的事件时，模特要么拒绝讨论这个话题，要么给出了委婉的回答。也许更令人惊讶的是，Anthropic 声称隶属于阿里巴巴 Qwen 实验室的运营商使用其 Claude 模型的输出，通过蒸馏来训练竞争的人工智能模型。 Hermes Agent 的制造商 Nous Research 指出，这种审查制度对于在中国训练的人工智能模型的用户来说是一个风险。人们对中国在科技行业的影响力进行更广泛的审查之际，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在美国情报机构指控一名女性为中国从事间谍活动引发争议后辞职，加剧了这种担忧。
诺斯表示，中国制造的人工智能模型带来的风险不仅仅是宣扬北京的世界观。根据与美国政府有很多业务往来的博思艾伦咨询公司的一项研究，一些中国模型被发现在某些条件下会产生更容易受到攻击的代码。供应商 Hirundo 表示，它正在构建“第一个机器学习平台，以确保人工智能模型只知道它们应该做什么”，也提出了同样的论点。该公司还指出，其对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 进行“遗忘”的努力导致产出急剧下降，这反映了中国共产党偏爱的审查制度、宣传信息或偏见。模型输出的 89.8% 反映了遗忘之前的这些值，将发生率降低至 2.8%。 Nous Research 并没有取得如此引人注目的结果，但确实看到被视为宣传的观点总体减少。该公司表示：“根据我们的评估，Arete-27B 将其事实得分从 2.32 提高到 2.98（满分 5 分），并将包含宣传的答案从 22% 削减到 1%，与我们测试的西方模型一致。”为了解决 Arete 的忘却问题，Nous Research 表示，它曾短暂考虑过 Nvidia 的 Nemotron 3 Ultra，“但发现有证据表明它在与中国相关的话题上也有不稳定的记录。”该公司表示：“我们并不清楚，但理论上认为 Nemotron 受到的偏见来自于在训练过程中与中国开放模型的合作。”
“我们也经历过类似的污染，因为绝大多数高质量的开放模型都是中国的，而且只有开放模型才有允许这种修补和实验的使用条款。”最终，该公司选择了美国 Thinking Machines Lab 的开放权重模型 Inkling 作为教学模型。 Nous Research 表示，其模型再教育工作表明，宣传层很浅，并且有 5000 万代币的监督学习，相对容易移除。 ®

【原文 English Original】
An American AI lab has re-educated Qwen3.8-27B, a popular open-weight large language model from Alibaba, so the software forgets its Chinese ancestry. Nous Research, an Austin, Texas-based AI lab, has subjected the model to re-education through training, not to be confused with China's " Re-education Through Labor " system. With the help of a post-training process, Qwen3.8-27B has been reborn under the name Arete "to reinforce Western values on a Chinese-trained model." What qualifies as a "Western value" remains open to interpretation. "Open-weight Chinese models are among the strongest available, but they ship with state-aligned behavior baked into the weights," Nous Research wrote in a blog post . Your correspondent tested this with a variant model, Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-6bit, locally. Asked about events during 1989 in Tiananmen Square, the model either refused to discuss the topic or provided euphemistic response. What's perhaps more surprising is that Anthropic claims operators affiliated with Alibaba's Qwen lab used outputs from its Claude models to train competing AI models via distillation . Nous Research, maker of the Hermes Agent , cites that sort of censorship as a risk for users of AI models trained in China. The concern comes amid broader scrutiny of Chinese influence in the tech industry, heightened by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation following controversy involving a woman US intelligence has accused of spying for China. Nous says the risk posed by Chinese-made AI models go beyond promoting Beijing's worldview. Some Middle Kingdom models have been found to produce more vulnerable code under certain conditions, according to a study by Booz Allen Hamilton, which does a lot of business with the US government. Hirundo, a vendor which says it is building "the first Machine Unlearning Platform to ensure that AI models only know what they should," makes the same argument . The company also notes that its efforts to apply "unlearning" to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B saw a dramatic drop in output that reflects Communist Party of China's preferred censorship, propaganda messaging, or bias. 89.8 percent of the model's output reflected those values before unlearning reduced the incidence to 2.8 percent. Nous Research did not achieve such dramatic results, but did see an overall reduction in viewpoints deemed to be propaganda. "On our evaluation, Arete-27B raised its fact score from 2.32 to 2.98 out of 5 and cut answers containing propaganda from 22 percent to 1 percent, in line with the Western models we tested," the company said. To handle Arete's unlearning, Nous Research says it briefly considered Nvidia's Nemotron 3 Ultra , "but had found evidence that it too had a checkered record on China-related topics." "We don't know definitively, but theorize that the bias imparted to Nemotron came from working with Chinese open models during the training process," the company said. "We have experienced similar contamination, because the vast majority of high quality open models are Chinese, and only open models have terms of use that permit this kind of tinkering and experimentation." In the end, the biz tapped Inkling , an open weight model from US-based Thinking Machines Lab, to act as the teaching model. Nous Research says its model re-education efforts show that the propaganda layer is shallow and, with 50 million tokens worth of supervised learning, is relatively easy to remove. ®

title: How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House
zh_title: 英伟达的性丑闻如何给白宫带来压力
summary: 唐纳德·特朗普和黄仁勋有多亲近？答案是非常。这位英伟达老板是少数能直接接触美国总统的商界领袖之一。他曾多次与特朗普会面，陪同他前往英国，并于五月与他一起乘坐空军一号前往中国。黄仁勋不仅仅是另一位寻求总统倾听的科技亿万富翁。他已成为政府内部最大争论之一的重要声音：应该允许多少美国最先进的技术进入中国。英伟达制造的芯片为人工智能革命提供动力。华盛顿已重新
content:
唐纳德·特朗普和黄仁勋有多亲近？答案是非常。这位英伟达老板是少数能直接接触美国总统的商界领袖之一。他曾多次与特朗普会面，陪同他前往英国，并于五月与他一起乘坐空军一号前往中国。黄仁勋不仅仅是另一位寻求总统倾听的科技亿万富翁。他已成为政府内部最大争论之一的重要声音：应该允许多少美国最先进的技术进入中国。英伟达制造的芯片为人工智能革命提供动力。自 2022 年以来，华盛顿一直限制向中国出口最先进的处理器，认为它们可以帮助北京发展其军事和技术能力。但执行这些限制很困难。新加坡和马来西亚等国家的客户可以合法购买芯片，然后转运到中国。中国公司还可以通过国外的数据中心租用计算能力。黄仁勋长期以来一直认为这些限制会适得其反。他们将英伟达排除在巨大市场之外，并鼓励中国公司开发自己的替代品。特朗普似乎赞同这一观点，允许英伟达去年恢复向中国销售某些芯片，以换取一部分收入，尽管其最先进的 Blackwell 芯片仍处于禁区。但这种关系现在看起来更加复杂。
围绕黄仁勋与新加坡公司 Megaspeed 前高管没有任何关系的黄仁勋的婚外情指控，提出了一种可能性，即外国情报行动的目标不仅是一位有权势的商人，而且是与美国总统关系异常密切的人。 据报道，美国情报部门怀疑爱丽丝黄与中国情报部门有联系。北京否认了这些指控。英伟达董事会表示，没有理由相信公司机密或国家安全受到损害。但这件事引发了一个更大的问题：华盛顿政府知道什么，又采取了什么措施？这个问题直接引向商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克。他的部门负责控制美国敏感技术的出口。它还因对英伟达客户 Megaspeed 的担忧而被迫采取行动，该客户涉嫌帮助将先进芯片转移到中国。周四，Megaspeed 首席执行官 Tan Yong Pong（又名 James Tan）表示，该公司“极其严肃地对待美国出口管制法规定的合规义务”，并“致力于与美国政府进行建设性和透明的合作”。他表示，该公司已配合美国商务部的检查。我们与 Lutnick 分享了一份高度机密的备忘录，内容涉及有关 Alice Huang 和 Megaspeed 的担忧。
他拒绝对该公司采取行动，这一决定目前正在接受审查。其他高级官员希望采取更严厉的回应。据报道，财政部长斯科特·贝森特（Scott Bessent）质疑为什么 Megaspeed 没有被列入商务部黑名单。还有人质疑为何在英伟达介入后停止了对这家新加坡公司的调查。 《纽约时报》报道称，英伟达总法律顾问联系了商务部调查人员，援引特朗普任命的一名高级官员，调查 Megaspeed 涉嫌走私芯片的行为。该部门

【原文 English Original】
How close is Donald Trump to Jensen Huang? The answer is very. The Nvidia boss was one of the few business leaders with direct access to the US president. He had met Trump repeatedly, travelled with him to Britain and, in May, joined him on Air Force One for his trip to China. Jensen Huang wasn’t just another tech billionaire seeking the president’s ear. He had become an important voice in one of the biggest arguments inside the administration: how much of America’s most advanced technology should be allowed to reach China. Nvidia makes the chips that power the AI revolution. Washington has restricted exports of its most advanced processors to China since 2022, believing they could help Beijing develop its military and technological capabilities. But enforcing those restrictions is difficult. Chips can be bought legally by customers in countries such as Singapore and Malaysia and then diverted to China. Chinese companies can also rent access to computing power through data centres outside the country. Jensen Huang has long argued that the restrictions are counterproductive. They shut Nvidia out of a huge market and encourage Chinese companies to develop their own alternatives. Trump appeared sympathetic to this view, allowing Nvidia to resume sales of certain chips to China last year in return for a share of the revenue, although its most advanced Blackwell chips remain off limits. But that relationship now looks rather more complicated. The allegations surrounding Jensen Huang’s reported affair with Alice Huang, of no relation but a former executive at Singapore-based company Megaspeed, have raised the possibility that a foreign intelligence operation was targeting not just a powerful businessman, but someone with unusually close access to the American president. US intelligence reportedly suspects Alice Huang of having links to Chinese intelligence. Beijing has rejected the allegations. Nvidia’s board says it has no reason to believe company secrets or national security were compromised. But the affair has opened up a much bigger question: what did the administration in Washington know, and what did it do about it? That question leads directly to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. His department was responsible for controlling exports of sensitive American technology. It was also being pressed to act on concerns about Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer suspected of helping divert advanced chips to China. On Thursday, Megaspeed chief executive, Tan Yong Pong, also known as James Tan, said the company “takes its compliance obligations under US export control laws extremely seriously” and is “committed to working constructively and transparently with the US government”. He said the company had co-operated with US Commerce Department inspections. A highly classified memo was shared with Lutnick about the concerns surrounding Alice Huang and Megaspeed. He resisted taking action against the company, a decision that is now under scrutiny. Other senior officials wanted a tougher response. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was among those who reportedly questioned why Megaspeed had not been placed on the Commerce Department’s blacklist. There were also questions about why an investigation into the Singapore-based company was stopped after Nvidia intervened. The New York Times reported that Nvidia’s general counsel contacted Commerce Department investigators probing suspected chip smuggling by Megaspeed, invoking a senior Trump appointee. The department allegedly then froze its investigation and handed the case to the Justice Department. This apparently highlighted a significant disagreement about the direction of Trump’s China policy. Huang wanted access to the Chinese market. Other officials were supposedly worried about the national security consequences. Lutnick was caught in the middle. Now the political pressure is building. Members of Congress from both parties want answers. Democrats have launched an investigation into how the Commerce Department vetted Chinese companies approved to buy AI chips. Republicans are also questioning the administration’s approach. And Jensen Huang’s departure has not eased the pressure. Republican representative John Moolenaar, who chairs the House Select Committee on China, said it was in the national interest for Nvidia and other American AI firms to succeed, but that companies “should never jeopardise our nation’s security” by giving Chinese firms access to their most advanced chips. Senator Elizabeth Warren, the top Democrat on the Senate Banking Committee, said Huang’s resignation did not absolve him of responsibility, and urged Lutnick to explain why export control loopholes remain open. Meanwhile Jensen Huang’s team told Republican lawmakers on Wednesday that he plans to cooperate with their request to testify behind closed doors. The White House has not responded to the BBC’s request for comment. It has, however, told the New York Post that Trump has complete confidence in Lutnick, describing him as “the most transformative commerce secretary in modern history”. That is a fairly emphatic show of support, particularly amid reports that officials are weighing whether Lutnick should be forced out. There are some obvious questions. If Lutnick had indeed been warned about the risks, why did his department fail to act? And if other senior officials were indeed pressing for action, why did it take so long? The BBC has contacted the Commerce Department for comment. But there is an even bigger question for Trump. The president cultivated a close relationship with Huang. He was directly involved in decisions about chip sales to China. And, according to reporting in the New York Times, he was briefed on the intelligence concerns. This is becoming difficult to dismiss as the misjudgement of one businessman or one government department. Jensen Huang’s personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself. How much influence did he have? What did the president know? And who was ultimately responsible for protecting America’s most sensitive technology?

Earlier higher arrivals still require mill purchases and port outbound volume to absorb them; higher seaborne quotes do not establish destocking. Recovering seaborne and domestic prices and broadly stable port products help ease pressure, while inventory accumulation and higher freight constrain sustained gains. title: Hong Kong’s Role in Offshore RMB Markets Grows Apace
zh_title: 香港在离岸人民币市场的地位迅速提升
summary: 香港在离岸人民币市场的作用迅速增强 - 东盟+3宏观经济研究室 - AMRO ASIA 本文首次于2026年11月3日发表于《中国日报》。人民币不断扩大的国际影响力正在开启中国与全球市场金融一体化的新篇章。其下一阶段的发展将不仅仅取决于跨境贸易中使用的增加。它还需要更深层次、更具流动性和国际联系的金融市场。中国人民银行在 10 月份发布的政策声明中重申了市场驱动的承诺
content:
香港在离岸人民币市场的地位迅速提升 - 东盟+3宏观经济研究办公室 - AMRO ASIA
本文首发于2026年11月3日《中国日报》。
人民币日益增长的国际影响力正在开启中国金融与全球市场一体化的新篇章。其下一阶段的发展将不仅仅取决于跨境贸易中使用的增加。它还需要更深层次、更具流动性和国际联系的金融市场。
在十月份发布的政策声明中，中国人民银行重申了对市场驱动的汇率和更大的双向货币灵活性的承诺。一个数字引人注目：据报道，大约 80% 的人民币外汇交易是在离岸进行的。
美元的主导地位不仅取决于其在贸易中的广泛使用，还取决于深厚的市场和丰富的流动资产。人民币不需要取代美元来发挥更重要的国际作用，但它确实需要更强大的金融生态系统。
作为世界领先的离岸人民币业务中心，中国香港完全有能力帮助建立这一生态系统。
自2009年推出跨境贸易人民币结算以来，人民币存款、贷款、债券和外汇交易市场大幅拓展。
最近的势头令人鼓舞。截至2025年底，人民币存款和存款证达到1.10万亿元人民币（1650亿美元），接近2014年1.16万亿元人民币的峰值。人民币贷款和点心债券发行也强劲扩张，到2025年分别达到9300亿元人民币和1.10万亿元人民币。
然而，人民币的大部分离岸流通仍然与涉及中国内地实体的交易挂钩，资金经常通过贸易和投资渠道回流境内。这种门户模式对香港来说效果很好。国际化的下一阶段可能涉及更多非内地同行之间的交易。
基础正在显现。 2020年以来，香港转口至内地的份额已超过原产地份额，扭转了历史格局。随着东盟+3供应链一体化的深入，这种转变可能会产生对人民币结算、融资和对冲服务的更大需求。
将这种势头转化为持久的国际需求需要在三个方面取得进展。
首先是流动性。可靠的国际融资货币需要随时获得流动性。这与人民币尤其相关，因为内地部分开放的资本账户可能会限制在岸和离岸市场之间的流动。
7月，香港金管局将人民币业务融资规模扩大至5000亿元人民币，并将融资期限延长至最长三年。除了改进离岸和跨境债券回购安排外，这些措施还加强了融资渠道。
成熟的离岸市场还需要活跃的银行间拆借、更深层次的回购市场和可靠的国际流动性渠道。香港可以成为连接内地资金来源与亚洲及其他地区金融机构的枢纽。
第二个挑战是给予投资者持有人民币的强烈动力。
贸易结算可以将货币转移到海外，但有吸引力的金融资产有助于将货币保留在海外。离岸人民币投资机会依然相对狭窄，二级市场流动性有限，市场关注度较高

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong's Role in Offshore RMB Markets Grows Apace - ASEAN+3 Macroeconomic Research Office - AMRO ASIA
This article was first published in China Daily on November 3, 2026.
The renminbi’s growing international reach is opening a new chapter in China’s financial integration with the global market. Its next stage of development will depend on more than just increasing use in cross-border trade. It will also require deeper, more liquid and internationally connected financial markets.
In a policy statement released in October, the People’s Bank of China reaffirmed its commitment to a market-driven exchange rate and greater two-way currency flexibility. One figure stood out: Around 80 percent of RMB foreign exchange trading was reported to take place offshore.
The US dollar’s dominance rests not simply on its widespread use in trade, but also on deep markets and abundant liquid assets. The RMB does not need to displace the dollar to play a more significant international role, but it does need a stronger financial ecosystem.
As the world’s leading offshore RMB business center, Hong Kong, China is well positioned to help build that ecosystem.
Since the introduction of cross-border RMB trade settlement in 2009, the city has substantially expanded its markets for RMB deposits, lending, bonds and foreign exchange transactions.
Recent momentum has been encouraging. As at end-2025, RMB deposits and certificates of deposit reached 1.10 trillion yuan ($165 billion), approaching their previous peak of 1.16 trillion yuan in 2014. RMB lending and dim-sum bond issuance have also expanded strongly, reaching 930 billion and 1.10 trillion yuan respectively in 2025.
Yet much of the RMB’s offshore circulation remains tied to transactions involving Chinese mainland entities, with funds frequently returning onshore through trade and investment channels. This gateway model has served Hong Kong well. The next stage of internationalization could involve more transactions among non-mainland counterparts.
The foundations are emerging. Since 2020, the share of Hong Kong’s re-exports destined for the mainland has exceeded the share originating there, reversing the historical pattern. Alongside deeper ASEAN+3 supply-chain integration, this shift could generate greater demand for RMB settlement, financing and hedging services.
Turning that momentum into lasting international demand requires progress on three fronts.
The first is liquidity. A reliable international funding currency requires ready access to liquidity. This is particularly relevant to the RMB because the mainland’s partially open capital account can constrain flows between onshore and offshore markets.
In July, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority expanded its RMB business facility to 500 billion yuan and extended funding tenors to up to three years. Alongside improvements to offshore and cross-boundary bond repurchase arrangements, these measures have strengthened access to funding.
A mature offshore market also needs active interbank lending, deeper repo markets and reliable international liquidity channels. Hong Kong could become a hub connecting mainland funding sources with financial institutions across Asia and beyond.
The second challenge is giving investors a strong incentive to hold RMB.
Trade settlement can bring a currency offshore, but attractive financial assets help keep it there. Offshore RMB investment opportunities remain relatively narrow, with limited secondary-market liquidity and a concentration of Chinese mainland-related assets.
Hong Kong could encourage greater issuance of renminbi-denominated bonds by foreign sovereigns, multilateral institutions and international companies. Renminbi-denominated funds tracking global equity benchmarks or markets in Japan, South Korea and ASEAN could also broaden investment opportunities.
Such products could attract international investors while allowing mainland investors to diversify overseas through established channels. They could also expand the RMB’s use in financing activities and acquiring assets beyond the mainland.
The third challenge is building networks that allow RMB to circulate globally.
International currencies benefit from network effects: The more widely a currency is used, the more attractive it becomes. Hong Kong already has important building blocks, including Bond Connect, Swap Connect and established payment and settlement infrastructure.
Further integration of the Cross-border Interbank Payment System and Hong Kong’s Central Moneymarkets Unit with international financial infrastructure could expand the reach of offshore RMB transactions. Regional arrangements for direct exchange and settlement between RMB and other Asian currencies could broaden payment options and improve efficiency.
Digital innovation, including tokenized financial assets, offers further opportunities to improve cross-border settlement. But technology is merely an enabler: Faster payments need sufficient assets, reliable funding and willing counterparties.
Deeper offshore markets would also require attention to liquidity risks, market segmentation and cross-border financial stability, supported by appropriate safeguards and cooperation among relevant authorities. Ultimately, the RMB’s international future will depend on China’s approach to financial opening, exchange rate flexibility and cross-border capital flows. A more market-driven exchange rate and deeper hedging markets can help accommodate more diverse flows. Stronger offshore liquidity arrangements can support market development consistent with domestic financial stability and the authorities’ approach to financial opening.
Hong Kong’s opportunity lies in developing markets and infrastructure that allow the RMB to be held, invested and used more widely across the region and beyond.

summary: 英伟达和黄仁勋并不是唯一受到关注的公司。这位长期担任科技高管的一周经历了糟糕的一周。这一切都始于黄与一名被指控为中国政府的间谍有婚外情的消息浮出水面。作为回应，黄仁勋 30 多年前共同创立的 Nvidia 公司董事会开始了调查。美国联邦调查局（FBI）也展开调查。周三有消息称，黄至少还发生过另一桩婚外情，这次是与一名直接向他汇报的公司高管发生了婚外情。到周四早上，黄仁勋已经辞职，芯片公司也
content:
英伟达和黄仁勋并不是唯一受到关注的公司。这位长期担任科技高管的一周经历了糟糕的一周。这一切都始于黄与一名被指控为中国政府的间谍有婚外情的消息浮出水面。作为回应，黄仁勋 30 多年前共同创立的 Nvidia 公司董事会开始了调查。美国联邦调查局（FBI）也展开调查。周三有消息称，黄至少还发生过另一桩婚外情，这次是与一名直接向他汇报的公司高管发生了婚外情。到周四早上，黄仁勋已经辞职，芯片公司任命了一位临时首席执行官。但热门歌曲不断涌现。周四下午，路透社报道称，黄与另一名员工发生了婚外情。显然，这对于英伟达来说是个坏消息。股市下跌，现在准备夺回国会的民主党人似乎正在加紧调查该公司以及美国国家安全可能面临的任何风险的计划。但这对于与英伟达的成功息息相关的一系列其他实体来说也是不利的。以下是一些感受到一些反弹的因素。白宫 刚刚在中期选举中遭受惨重损失的白宫将面临质疑，为什么它在得知黄与一名涉嫌间谍的恋情后推迟采取行动。
特朗普政府在安全和情报实践方面的声誉本来就很差，但似乎对这些知识的忽视几乎肯定会增加进一步调查的可能性。值得注意的是，特朗普官员已经批准了允许英伟达向中国出售先进计算机芯片的协议，甚至在地缘政治谈判中利用美国对该公司芯片的影响力。 NVIDIA 现有和潜在客户美国人工智能供应链在 Nvidia 上运行。 OpenAI、Anthropic 和许多其他大型语言模型开发人员都依赖该公司的硬件。 Meta、微软和甲骨文也是主要客户。这在很大程度上是因为 GPU（或图形处理单元）特别擅长开发大型推理模型所需的计算。现在，由于对英伟达的审查如此之多，这些公司以及任何正在进行的交易都可能面临阻力，因为仍在混乱的董事会正在考虑下一步该做什么。支持芯片公司的主要贸易组织半导体行业协会拒绝发表评论。今年早些时候同意被英伟达收购的人工智能开发商 Hugging Face 没有回应置评请求。值得注意的是，黄似乎没有继任计划。 Nvidia 首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 于周四上午被任命为临时首席执行官。丑闻和混乱不仅对需要英伟达芯片的美国公司不利。
考虑到黄仁勋主张放宽对中国芯片销售限制的程度，任何涉嫌与中国政府有联系的客户也可能会看到英伟达交易受到比以前更严格的审查。联邦机构美国政府是英伟达的主要支持者，在自己的系统（包括机密网络）中广泛使用该公司的技术。本周的爆料不仅让政府感到尴尬，而且引发了人们的担忧：政府官员对黄与一名涉嫌中国间谍的恋情的了解程度，以及他们可能如何影响该公司与联邦机构的往来。一位前联邦首席信息官告诉《快公司》

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia and Jensen Huang aren’t the only ones in the crosshairs.  The longtime tech executive has had a bad week. It all began when news surfaced that Huang had been having an extramarital affair with an alleged spy for the Chinese government. In response, the corporate board of Nvidia—the company Huang cofounded more than 30 years ago—began an investigation. The FBI launched a probe, too. Then news broke Wednesday that Huang had engaged in at least one other affair, this time with a company executive who reported directly to him. By Thursday morning, Huang had resigned , and the chip company had appointed an interim CEO. But the hits kept coming. Thursday afternoon Reuters reported that Huang had engaged in an affair with a second employee . Obviously, this is bad news for Nvidia. Stocks are down, and Democrats, now preparing to take back Congress, appear to be ramping up plans to investigate the company and any possible risks to U.S. national security. But this is also bad for a range of other entities that have a stake in Nvidia’s success. Here are a few that stand to feel some of the blowback. The White House The White House, fresh off of devastating losses in the midterm elections, stands to face questions about why it held off on taking action after it learned about Huang’s affair with an alleged spy. The Trump administration already had a poor reputation for security and intelligence practices, but seemingly sleeping on this knowledge is all but certain to raise the prospect of further probes. Trump officials, notably, have cleared deals allowing Nvidia to sell advanced computer chips to China, and even leveraged U.S. influence over the company’s chips in geopolitical negotiations. Current and prospective NVIDIA customers The U.S. AI supply chain runs on Nvidia. OpenAI, Anthropic, and a slew of other large language model developers rely on the company’s hardware. Meta, Microsoft, and Oracle are also major customers. This is, in large part, because GPUs—or graphics processing units—are particularly adept at the kinds of computations needed to develop large reasoning models.  Now, with so much scrutiny on Nvidia, there’s a risk those companies—and any deals in progress—might face headwinds as the still-scrambling board figures out what to do next. The Semiconductor Industry Association, a major trade group that advocates for chip companies, declined to comment. Hugging Face, an AI developer that agreed to an acquisition by Nvidia earlier this year, did not respond to a request for comment.  Remarkably, Huang doesn’t seem to have had a succession plan. Colette Kress, Nvidia’s chief financial officer, was appointed interim CEO on Thursday morning. The scandal and disarray isn’t just bad for American companies that need Nvidia’s chips. Given the extent to which Huang advocated for loosening chip sale limits to China, any customers with suspected links to the Chinese government may also see far more scrutiny on Nvidia deals than before. U.S. federal agencies The U.S. government is a major supporter of Nvidia, using the company’s tech extensively in its own systems, including classified networks . The revelations this week are not only embarrassing for the government, but raise concerns about the extent to which government officials were aware of Huang’s affair with a suspected spy for China, and how they might have influenced the company’s dealings with federal agencies. One former federal chief information officer told Fast Company that the scandal raises suspicions that the U.S. security clearance system, which is supposed to engage in continuous monitoring, isn’t as up to snuff as it should be. Everyone else  We really are that dependent on Nvidia. If we learned anything from the chip shortage we experienced during the pandemic, the semiconductor market is heavily concentrated, and disruptions with just one company can quickly ripple through the economy. In 2020, it was companies like TSMC, a Taiwan-based contract manufacturer that supplies chips for a host of devices. And the stock market—including pension funds and 401(k) plans—are deeply exposed to Nvidia stock. “It is striking that Nvidia, a $4 trillion company central to both the AI economy and U.S. equity markets, appears to have no publicly identified successor to Jensen Huang,” Ann Lewis, a technology executive and former U.S. government tech official, told Fast Company Wednesday. “In cybersecurity, we call this a single point of failure. A company of this scale should not depend so completely on one person’s relationships and judgment.”

content:
中国北京——英伟达表示，美国的出口管制实际上将其排除在中国人工智能数据中心市场之外，但路透社的一项评论发现，围绕这家美国芯片制造商的受限处理器构建的中国计算项目价值超过 30 亿美元。这些项目从中国富裕的沿海技术中心延伸到偏远的西部省份，揭示了对英伟达硬件的持续需求规模，尽管华盛顿试图遏制北京获取推动全球人工智能繁荣的技术。路透社的审查审查了超过 150 份中国采购通知、投资计划、建筑合同和公司披露信息，确定了总报告价值超过 230 亿元人民币（32 亿美元）的项目和设备协议。调查结果详细描绘了英伟达技术在中国人工智能扩张中的嵌入程度。他们透露，该公司的技术远远超出了中国最大的科技公司，还进入了地方政府支持的企业、大学和区域计算中心。该估算包括计划投资和已签署的合同以及已完成的安装。它涵盖了建筑物、电力系统和其他基础设施，并且不仅仅反映了英伟达芯片上的支出。中国商务部和英伟达没有立即回应路透社的置评请求。
就在这一调查结果发布的前一天，英伟达联合创始人黄仁勋因与一名中国女商人的关系丑闻而辞去首席执行官职务，美国当局怀疑他与北京有情报关系。 必读英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋辞职，对人工智能热潮造成重大打击黄仁勋是放宽出口限制的直言不讳的倡导者，他表示去年英伟达在中国的市场份额已从 95% 降至零。该公司还以监管不确定性为由，将中国数据中心计算收入排除在预测之外。这并不意味着中国的需求已经消失。尽管英伟达的声明谈到了其自身在中国竞争和直接销售的能力，但路透社查阅的文件显示，中国客户仍在计划采购，并在某些情况下运行受限制的处理器。总部位于华盛顿的詹姆斯敦基金会分析师 Sunny Cheung 表示，路透社的调查结果强化了他自己对执法的看法：“华盛顿必须停止仅仅关注谁购买了地面芯片，而开始审查谁最终使用了计算能力，以及出于什么目的。”数十亿美元正在筹备中 在中国各地，开发商和机构正在推进数十亿美元的人工智能数据中心项目，这些项目围绕受限的 Nvidia H100、H200 和 H800 处理器而设计。
这些范围从大型区域计算中心到改造后的商业站点，例如甘肃省西北部的一个设施，预计将在年底前安装数千个 Nvidia 芯片，但目前还不清楚这些处理器是否已到达。虽然一些设施已经投入运营或正在建设中，但随着出口管制的收紧，运营商面临着潜在的延误、供应中断或围绕国内芯片进行成本高昂的重新设计的风险。随着美国立法者敦促加强控制，黄仁勋的离职可能会削弱英伟达的游说影响力，从而加深这些漏洞。华盛顿的困境华盛顿从 2022 年开始限制 Nvidia 的先进人工智能处理器，随后加强了对为中国开发的修改芯片（包括 H800）的控制。一月份，特朗普政府

【原文 English Original】
BEIJING, China – Nvidia has said US export controls have effectively shut it out of China’s AI data-center market, but a Reuters review has identified more than $3 billion in Chinese computing projects built around the American chipmaker’s restricted processors. The projects, stretching from China’s wealthy coastal technology hubs to remote western provinces, reveal the scale of continuing demand for Nvidia hardware even as Washington seeks to curb Beijing’s access to the technology powering the global artificial-intelligence boom. The Reuters review examined more than 150 Chinese procurement notices, investment plans, construction contracts and corporate disclosures, identifying projects and equipment agreements with a combined reported value exceeding 23 billion yuan ($3.2 billion). The findings paint a detailed picture of how deeply Nvidia technology remains embedded in China’s AI expansion. They reveal the company’s technology reaches well beyond China’s largest tech firms, into local government-backed ventures, universities and regional computing centres. The estimate includes planned investments and signed contracts as well as completed installations. It covers buildings, power systems and other infrastructure, and does not reflect spending on Nvidia chips alone. China’s commerce ministry and Nvidia did not immedietely respond to Reuters request for comment. The findings come a day after Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive amid a scandal over his relationship with a Chinese businesswoman suspected by US authorities of intelligence ties to Beijing. Must Read Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down in big blow to AI boom Huang, a vocal advocate of easing export restrictions, said last year Nvidia’s market share in China had fallen from 95% to zero. The company has also excluded China data-center computing revenue from its forecasts, citing regulatory uncertainty. That does not mean Chinese demand has disappeared. While Nvidia’s statements address its own ability to compete and sell directly in China, the documents Reuters reviewed show Chinese customers continuing to plan purchases and, in some cases, operating restricted processors. Sunny Cheung, an analyst at the Washington-based Jamestown Foundation, said Reuters’ findings reinforce his own view on enforcement: “Washington must stop focusing solely on who buys the chips on the surface and start examining who ultimately uses the computing power—and for what purpose.” Billions in the pipeline Across China, developers and institutions are advancing billions of dollars in AI data-centre projects designed around restricted Nvidia H100, H200, and H800 processors. These range from massive regional computing hubs to retrofitted commercial sites — such as a facility in northwestern Gansu province that was expected to install thousands of Nvidia chips before year-end, though it remains unclear if those processors ever arrived. While some facilities are already operational or under construction, operators are exposed to potential delays, supply disruptions, or costly redesigns around domestic chips as export controls tighten. Huang’s departure could deepen these vulnerabilities by weakening Nvidia’s lobbying leverage as US lawmakers press for tighter controls. Washington’s dilemma Washington began restricting Nvidia’s advanced AI processors in 2022 and subsequently tightened controls on modified chips developed for China, including the H800. In January, the Trump administration moved to review H200 export licences for eligible Chinese customers individually, subject to conditions. Nvidia’s August filing said it was effectively excluded from China’s data-center computing market. But an IDC report cited by Reuters in October estimated Nvidia still accounted for 34% of Chinese AI-accelerator shipments in the first half of 2026. The figures measure different things and do not establish how the restricted hardware identified in the Reuters investigation reached Chinese users. The scrutiny has intensified since Huang’s resignation on Thursday, following allegations involving Alice Huang, a former executive associated with Singapore-based Nvidia cloud partner Megaspeed. Megaspeed has denied illegally diverting Nvidia chips to China. Nvidia’s board launched an independent investigation, saying it had no reason to believe company secrets or US national security were compromised. There has been no public finding that Jensen Huang violated export-control laws. The Chinese projects identified by Reuters have not been linked to Megaspeed or the allegations involving Huang. – Rappler.com
