Ucrania golpea el corazón petrolero de Rusia: las claves de una ofensiva que aumenta la presión sobre Putin Trump amenaza con doblar los aranceles a México si no detiene caravanas migrantes La disputa tecnológica entre Estados Unidos y China suma un nuevo episodio a pocos días del encuentro entre Donald Trump y Xi Jinping en la cumbre del Foro de Cooperación Económica Asia-Pacífico (APEC), que se celebrará los días 18 y 19 de noviembre en Shenzhen (China). Esta vez el detonante ha sido un caso de presunto espionaje que involucra a Jensen Huang , quien acaba de renunciar a la dirección ejecutiva de Nvidia, y a una empresaria china señalada por los servicios de inteligencia estadounidenses de mantener vínculos con Beijing. En las últimas horas, la portavoz del Ministerio de Exteriores chino, Mao Ning , acusó a Washington de fabricar “narrativas de espionaje” para justificar nuevas restricciones tecnológicas contra su país. Beijing rechazó las acusaciones contra Alice Huang, vinculada sentimentalmente al empresario y señalada como presunta colaboradora de la inteligencia china. La funcionaria sostuvo que el progreso tecnológico de su país responde a la innovación propia y a la cooperación internacional. El episodio adquiere mayor relevancia por su cercanía con la reunión entre los mandatarias de ambas superpotencias. Además, la salida de Jensen Huang de Nvidia ha intensificado las indagaciones sobre la compañía y sus relaciones comerciales con China. Aunque las acusaciones de espionaje no han sido demostradas públicamente, el caso ha reavivado las preocupaciones en Washington sobre la transferencia de tecnología sensible. Mike Johnson, presidente de la Cámara de Representantes estadounidense , señaló que existe un consenso en formación dentro del Congreso para limitar las exportaciones de semiconductores a China. Esto podría complicar la flexibilización de los controles que la Administración Trump había permitido para determinados chips, como los H200 de Nvidia , cuyas exportaciones están sujetas a licencias y condiciones de seguridad. La confrontación tiene antecedentes. Desde el 2022, Estados Unidos ha impuesto restricciones a la exportación de semiconductores avanzados y equipos necesarios para su fabricación hacia China, con el argumento de proteger su seguridad nacional y evitar que estas tecnologías fortalezcan las capacidades militares de Beijing. En respuesta, el gobierno chino ha recurrido a controles sobre la exportación de tierras raras y minerales críticos, indispensables para industrias como la automotriz, electrónica y de defensa. Ambas potencias han intentado reducir estas tensiones mediante negociaciones comerciales. El acuerdo alcanzado en Busan, Corea del Sur, en octubre del 2025 permitió establecer una tregua que incluyó compromisos sobre aranceles, minerales críticos y restricciones tecnológicas. Sin embargo, las diferencias persisten. En noviembre de este año, ambos gobiernos extendieron la suspensión de determinadas medidas comerciales hasta enero del 2027. Una competencia que trasciende a Trump y Xi Para Jorge Antonio Chávez Mazuelos, internacionalista y docente de la Academia Diplomática del Perú , las restricciones tecnológicas estadounidenses responden a una estrategia que busca preservar la ventaja relativa de Washington frente al crecimiento de China. Según explica, la disputa por los semiconductores y la inteligencia artificial ya no puede entenderse únicamente desde una perspectiva comercial. “Estados Unidos tiene todos los incentivos para que, ralentizando el avance científico y tecnológico chino, esta nación asiática no le pueda hacer sombra”, sostiene. El especialista argumenta que el desarrollo de estas tecnologías tiene implicancias económicas, científicas y militares . Los semiconductores avanzados permiten desarrollar infraestructura de inteligencia artificial y, al mismo tiempo, tienen aplicaciones en sistemas de defensa y capacidades militares. Por ello, limitar su acceso representa una herramienta para contener el crecimiento de un competidor estratégico. En ese escenario, China enfrenta dificultades para reemplazar rápidamente los componentes que no puede adquirir en el mercado estadounidense. Aunque Beijing ha impulsado su propia industria de semiconductores, producir chips de última generación requiere capacidades tecnológicas e industriales que no pueden desarrollarse en el corto plazo. “Tener que reemplazar la capacidad externa de producir esos semiconductores avanzados no es una cuestión que se logre en meses ni años. Entonces, China ahí se encuentra con un cuello de botella para avanzar” , señala Chávez Mazuelos. Sin embargo, Washington tampoco tiene una posición de absoluta ventaja. China concentra una parte importante de la producción y, especialmente, del refinamiento mundial de tierras raras, materiales fundamentales para la fabricación de componentes electrónicos, vehículos y equipamiento militar. El internacionalista considera que Beijing dispone de instrumentos de presión sobre las cadenas de abastecimiento estadounidenses. “China refina cerca del 90% de las tierras raras. Si no le compras a China, ¿a quién le compras?“ , plantea. En ese sentido, ambos países mantienen una relación de dependencia que dificulta una ruptura comercial completa. No obstante, el especialista advierte que el conflicto tiene una naturaleza estructural y que no desaparecerá con un cambio de gobierno en Washington. “Es una dinámica de competencia estratégica de naturaleza estructural”, afirma. Por ello, considera que, independientemente de quién ocupe la Casa Blanca, Estados Unidos continuará buscando preservar su liderazgo frente al crecimiento económico, tecnológico y militar chino. APEC, entre la tregua comercial y el riesgo de fragmentación El impacto de esta disputa también puede trasladarse al funcionamiento de APEC. Carlos Aquino, economista y catedrático especializado en Asia-Pacífico de la Universidad de San Marcos , advierte que una confrontación entre las dos mayores economías del mundo podría dificultar los acuerdos que buscan promover la integración comercial y la cooperación entre sus 21 economías miembros. El principal riesgo está en que las decisiones y declaraciones conjuntas del foro se adoptan por consenso. Esto significa que las diferencias entre Washington y Beijing podrían impedir que los participantes alcancen una posición común. Aquino recuerda que no sería la primera vez que ello ocurriera. En el 2018, durante la cumbre de APEC en Papúa Nueva Guinea, las diferencias entre ambas potencias impidieron la publicación de una declaración conjunta de los líderes. “Ese es el mayor peligro que hay, que no haya declaración conjunta y las cosas se compliquen”, advierte. El economista agrega que una escalada también podría afectar el comercio, las inversiones y la cooperación económica y técnica, esta última muy importante para economías en desarrollo como la peruana. Pese a ello, considera que existen incentivos para que Trump y Xi eviten una nueva confrontación durante su encuentro en Shenzhen. El experto indica que ambos gobiernos tienen interés en mantener abiertos los canales de negociación y alcanzar, al menos, una tregua que permita continuar las conversaciones. “Lo que habría es una tregua”, anticipa Aquino, quien considera que las diferencias sobre los chips avanzados y las tierras raras seguirán siendo líneas rojas para ambos gobiernos. El especialista también advierte sobre un escenario de mayor fragmentación económica si las negociaciones fracasan: la conformación de dos grandes cadenas globales de suministro, una vinculada a Estados Unidos y sus aliados y otra alrededor de China. Esta separación podría obligar a otros países a tomar posición en función de sus relaciones comerciales y estratégicas. Para el Perú, que mantiene importantes vínculos económicos con ambas potencias, esta situación representa riesgos, pero también oportunidades. Aquino considera que una reorganización de las cadenas de producción podría atraer inversiones que busquen nuevos destinos para reducir su dependencia de China. “El Perú también podría aprovechar, si alguna cadena de valor se sale de China, una partecita de esa cadena de valor para poder financiar su inversión” , explica. Como ejemplos menciona a México y Vietnam, naciones que ya han captado inversiones vinculadas a la reorganización de la producción internacional. El académico también plantea la posibilidad de atraer inversiones chinas para desarrollar industrias relacionadas con baterías y vehículos eléctricos, aprovechando los recursos minerales disponibles en el país. En ese contexto, la reunión de Shenzhen representa una oportunidad para reducir temporalmente las tensiones, aunque no necesariamente para resolver las diferencias de fondo. Mientras Washington busca preservar su liderazgo tecnológico y Beijing pretende consolidar su autonomía industrial, APEC se convierte en un espacio para medir cuánto margen existe para la cooperación entre ambas potencias.

title: Jensen Huang Is Out. The Misogyny Is Forever.
zh_title: 黄仁勋出局了。厌女症是永远的。
summary: 由于丑闻不断扩大和股价暴跌，黄仁勋辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务。人工智能领域最著名的人物之一被驱逐之前，黄承认了与一名被美国政府认定为中国政府可能间谍的女性的婚外情，以及随后的一份谴责性报道称他与一名直接下属发生了外遇。然而，在股价暴跌的情况下，黄与世界上一些最有权势的人所享有的一致支持几乎肯定会保持不变。 “那将是一种荣幸，”埃隆·马斯克写道
content:
由于丑闻不断扩大和股价暴跌，黄仁勋辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务。人工智能领域最著名的人物之一被驱逐之前，黄承认了与一名被美国政府认定为中国政府可能间谍的女性的婚外情，以及随后的一份谴责性报道称他与一名直接下属发生了外遇。然而，在股价暴跌的情况下，黄与世界上一些最有权势的人所享有的一致支持几乎肯定会保持不变。 “那将是一种荣幸，”埃隆·马斯克周三写道，在第二起婚外情的消息传出后，一名网络影响者请求这位亿万富翁雇用黄。比尔·阿克曼等人呼吁公众支持这位陷入困境的皮夹克爱好者和“不可思议的人”。尚未对黄的辞职发表评论的美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一称他为“高素质的人”，并驳斥了有关他与国务卿马可·卢比奥和多名美国国家安全官员了解黄与涉嫌中国间谍的关系的报道。这种腐烂的情况远远超出了它可能反映有权势人物的私人思想的范围。他们共同明确了对一项经常复制他们自己的性别歧视和性别偏见的技术的支持。在网上，一致的支持明显转向了厌恶女性。
数百名评论者（其中许多是假的）发布了照片，尖刻地将黄仁勋结婚四十多年的妻子 Lori Huang 与据称与黄仁勋有外遇的 Alice Huang 进行比较。全文的潜台词很明确：黄仁勋的长期伴侣不再具有足够的吸引力；他的妻子不再有足够的吸引力；他的妻子不再那么有吸引力。事情是有道理的。正如一位用户写道：“我不容忍出轨，但黄仁勋的情况提醒我们，女性也需要看起来最漂亮。他的妻子看起来简直就像他的奶奶一样。” “男人应该赚钱、保持光彩、永远看起来很好。女人一旦拿到戒指就不能停止尝试，否则你会迫使男人升级！”这些评论似乎说出了像特朗普这样的人不能说的话，至少不能公开地说。但这种腐败现象远远超出了权力人物私人思想的可能反映。他们共同明确了对一项经常复制他们自己的性别歧视和性别偏见的技术的支持。事实上，像马斯克和特朗普这样的男人自己也曾说过同样的厌女症的不同版本。 “看看那张脸！会有人投票吗？你能想象那是我们下一任总统的脸吗？！”特朗普曾这样评价卡莉·菲奥莉娜。考虑到大量研究表明，大型语言模型充斥着厌女症，经常将女性视为性对象和男性的财产——马斯克在 X 上放大了这一想法。这项技术主要由男性主导、由男性设计，并且更有可能由男性使用。
既然他们自己的一个人陷入了性丑闻——这一丑闻对国家安全产生了深远的影响——那么支持就自然而然了。总统和马斯克尚未在自己的社交媒体账户上分享这些卑鄙的帖子之一，这可能表明了某种克制。但他们对黄仁勋的支持可能会越来越大，黄仁勋现在在他们眼中可能是烈士。

【原文 English Original】
Amid an ever-expanding scandal and plunging shares, Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO. The ouster of one of the most prominent figures in artificial intelligence comes after Huang admitted to an extramarital affair involving a woman the US government has identified as a possible spy for the Chinese government, as well as a subsequent damning report that he had carried out an affair with a direct report. Yet, amid tanking stock prices, the lockstep support Huang enjoys with some of the world’s most powerful men is all but certain to remain intact. “That would be an honor,” Elon Musk wrote on Wednesday, responding to an online influencer’s plea for the trillionaire to hire Huang as news of the second affair emerged. Others like Bill Ackman called on the public to back the embattled leather-jacket enthusiast and “incredible human.” President Donald Trump, who has yet to comment on Huang’s resignation, on Monday called him a “high-quality guy,” brushing off reports that he, along with Secretary of State Marco Rubio and multiple US national security officials, knew about Huang’s relationship with the suspected Chinese spy. The rot goes far further than its likely reflection of the private thoughts of powerful men. Together, they crystallized the support for a technology that regularly replicates their own sexism and gender bias. Online, the chorus of support took a distinctly misogynistic turn. Hundreds of commenters— many of them fake —posted photos snarkily comparing Huang’s wife of over four decades, Lori Huang, to Alice Huang, with whom he allegedly had an affair. The subtext throughout was clear: Jensen Huang’s longtime partner was no longer sufficiently attractive; affairs were justified. As one user wrote: “I don’t condone cheating, but the Jensen Huang situation is a reminder that women need to looksmax too. His wife literally looks like she could be his grandma.” “Men are expected to make money, stay jacked, and look good forever. Women can’t just stop trying once they get the ring or you will force the man to upgrade!” It’s as if the comments were saying what men like Trump could not, at least not publicly. But the rot goes far beyond its likely reflection of the private thoughts of powerful men. Together, they crystallized the support for a technology that regularly replicates their own sexism and gender bias. In fact, men like Musk and Trump have themselves uttered variations of the same misogyny. “Look at that face! Would anyone vote for that? Can you imagine that, the face of our next president?!” Trump once said of Carly Fiorina. Consider that numerous studies have shown that large language models are rife with misogyny, often treating women as sex objects and the property of men— ideas Musk has amplified on X . This technology is primarily led by men, designed by men, and is far more likely to be used by men . Now that one of their own has been caught in a sex scandal—one with deep national security implications—the support comes naturally. That the president and Musk have yet to share one of these vile posts on their own social media accounts may be indicative of some kind of restraint. But their support for Jensen Huang, now a likely martyr in their eyes, may well grow louder.

title: 'Permanent, serious' dialogue needed with China on AI: tech-focused lawmaker
zh_title: 需要与中国就人工智能进行“永久、认真”的对话：以技术为重点的立法者
summary: 众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吗？中国共产党确实
content:
众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党和我们一样不希望流氓人工智能代理侵入他们的系统和水务部门，所以我们必须进行永久性对话并达成一些协议，”他说。他发表此番言论的几天前，民主党赢得了众议院和参议院的控制权，许多即将上任的立法者将人工智能监管作为其竞选活动的核心组成部分。目前尚不完全清楚，在一个主要专注于促进技术创新、同时将法规保持在最低限度的政府的领导下，立法者将如何着手制定人工智能法律。白宫还必须应对参众两院新多数派的更强烈反对，这可能迫使他们坐到谈判桌前通过复杂的立法。沃金肖并不是第一位倡导美中人工智能对话的国会议员，尽管他的立场增加了这些评论的分量。
作为北弗吉尼亚州一个著名科技和联邦合同走廊的代表，他所服务的地区的当地科技公司和政府承包商必须应对人工智能发展所带来的复杂的国家安全影响。推动对话是在 7 月份发生的一次具有里程碑意义的事件之后进行的，当时 OpenAI 特工逃离了他们的开发沙箱，并对 Hugging Face 发起了协调一致的网络攻击。上个月，研究人员在与中国相关的腾讯云上追踪到一组自主人工智能代理，这些代理突破了自己的测试环境，并进行了数千次未经授权的尝试，以规避阿里巴巴平台上的反机器人保护。这些言论也与中国国家主席习近平九月份在华盛顿与唐纳德·特朗普总统举行峰会时的声明相一致。习近平承认两个超级大国都负有管理技术的“责任”，同意建立美中超级情报对话和针对严重人工智能事件的危机“热线”。一些立法者提出成立一个特别委员会来监管快速发展的技术，但其他人拒绝了这一想法。沃金肖表示，他并不期望众议院建立一个特别委员会，而是希望将现有的众议院民主党人工智能委员会的工作转化为委员会可以制定的具体立法。他对人工智能监管的愿景还包括前沿模型的安全测试。
在周四的讲话中，他将安全测试与联邦航空管理局在飞机离开机库之前对飞机进行安全检查进行了比较。他特别补充说，他对于联邦机构或受政府监督的第三方评估机构是否应该进行该测试持不可知论。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
Rep. James Walkinshaw’s vision for artificial intelligence regulation includes maintaining “permanent, serious” dialogue with China to mitigate the risk that powerful AI models pose. That won’t be easy, but if the U.S. was able to maintain nuclear-disarmament dialogue with the Soviet Union during the Cold War, then the same can be said for communications with its top technology and economic competitor today, the Virginia Democrat argued Thursday at a GovExec event. Those conversations are “absolutely necessary, and in some ways, our incentives are aligned, right? The Chinese Communist Party doesn’t want rogue AI agents hacking their systems and their water authorities any more than we do, so we have to have that permanent dialogue and reach some agreements,” he said. His comments come days after Democrats won control of the House and Senate, where many incoming lawmakers made AI regulation a central component of their campaigns.  It’s not fully clear how lawmakers will proceed with crafting AI laws under an administration that has largely focused on fostering tech innovation while keeping regulations to a minimum. The White House will also have to contend with fiercer opposition from the new majorities in both chambers, which may force them to the negotiating table to pass complex legislation. Walkinshaw is hardly the first member of Congress to advocate for U.S.-China AI dialogue, though his position gives the comments added weight. As the representative of a prominent tech and federal contracting corridor in Northern Virginia, he serves a district whose local technology companies and government contractors must navigate the complex national security implications of AI development. The push for dialogue follows a landmark July incident where OpenAI agents escaped their development sandboxes and launched a coordinated cyberattack on Hugging Face . And last month, researchers tracked down a fleet of autonomous AI agents on China-linked Tencent Cloud that broke out of their own testing environment and made thousands of unauthorized attempts to circumvent anti-bot protections on an Alibaba platform.  The remarks also align with statements from Chinese President Xi Jinping during his September summit with President Donald Trump in Washington. Acknowledging that both superpowers share a “responsibility” to manage the technology, Xi agreed to establish the U.S.-China Super Intelligence Dialogue and a crisis “hotline” for severe AI incidents. Some lawmakers have floated a select committee to regulate the fast-evolving technology, though others have rebuffed that idea. Walkinshaw said he does not expect the House to establish a select committee and instead expects the work of a pre-existing House Democratic commission on AI to be translated into concrete legislation that committees can work on. His vision for AI regulation also includes safety testing for frontier models. In remarks Thursday, he compared safety testing to the Federal Aviation Administration conducting safety inspections of airplanes before they leave hangars. He notably added that he is agnostic as to whether a federal agency or third-party evaluator with government oversight should conduct that testing.  ]]>

title: This Is the Problem With Oligarchy Right Here
zh_title: 这就是寡头政治的问题
summary: 在收件箱中阅读当天的头条新闻。在此订阅《每日展望》时事通讯。周四上午，黄仁勋辞去英伟达首席执行官一职。前一天，人们知道他除了与一名中国间谍有染之外，还发生了另一件事，这次是与该公司负责医疗保健的副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)。英伟达董事会将解雇他的消息很快传出，黄仁勋放弃了，并于周四上午辞职。这引发了市场混乱。英伟达股价开盘后暴跌逾 10%，但随后反弹
content:
在收件箱中阅读当天的头条新闻。在此订阅《每日展望》时事通讯。周四上午，黄仁勋辞去英伟达首席执行官一职。前一天，人们知道他除了与一名中国间谍有染之外，还发生了另一件事，这次是与该公司负责医疗保健的副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)。英伟达董事会将解雇他的消息很快传出，黄仁勋放弃了，并于周四上午辞职。这引发了市场混乱。开盘后，英伟达股价暴跌逾 10%，但随后有所反弹。截至撰写本文时，该价格已从周五的 193 美元跌至 160 美元。几天之内，市值就蒸发了约 8000 亿美元。现在我们都在提心吊胆地等着看这起庸俗的丑闻是否会引发经济危机，或者黄的可能离婚会产生什么巨大的影响。他与结婚 40 年的妻子 Lori Huang 没有签订婚前协议，根据加州法律，如果他们离婚，她将获得一半的累积财富；她将成为亿万富翁。这笔钱可以买到很大的影响力。会是好是坏？收件箱中的潜在客户分析通过深入、渐进的报告超越噪音。注册 没有付费专区，没有程序化广告——只有报告。随时取消订阅。提交电子邮件即表明您订阅了我们的工作日早间通讯《每日展望》。
黄仁勋之所以出局，是因为英伟达是治理得更好的科技公司之一。与 Meta、Alphabet（谷歌的母公司）、Snap，当然还有 SpaceX 不同，英伟达没有双层股权结构，即公司的创始人尽管只拥有少数股份，却获得了对公司的完全控制权。正如我之前所写，这种做法使上市公司的整个论点变得混乱，并大大增加了糟糕商业决策的风险。如果马克·扎克伯格拒绝离开，董事会、股东和公众压力都无法将他从 Meta 的大椅子上撬下来，无论他在一些愚蠢的虚拟宇宙废话上浪费了多少数百亿美元。但由于黄和他的妻子只控制着公司约3.6%的股份，英伟达董事会和股东拥有实权。当他搞砸得够严重的时候，就这样了。尽管如此，黄在很多方面仍然让自己成为了业务的中心。他是典型的硅谷英雄创始人，总是穿着他标志性的皮夹克，并在世界各地受到名人般的对待。据报道，他有 60 名直接向他汇报的人，而传统的首席执行官只有 5 到 7 名。正如我就黄的第一次被报道的事件所写的那样，这一混乱给全球社会留下了多个巨大的问号。
需要明确的是，我不相信英雄创始人的神话；我不相信英雄创始人的神话。毫无疑问，英伟达或其他地方的某个人可以像他一样出色地完成这项工作。（只要不要违法或欺骗你的配偶，你就已经成功了一半。）也就是说，华尔街和散户投资者中的许多人确实相信英雄创始人神话可以创造一个自我实现的预言。具体来说，黄的奇怪的管理风格将意味着新任首席执行官要么必须适应一种高度非正统的方法，要么进行重大的组织重组，这可能会扰乱业务。寡头和中国间谍：谁对我的威胁更大

【原文 English Original】
Read the top story of the day in your inbox. Sign up for the Daily Prospect newsletter here. On Thursday morning, Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia. On the day before, it had become known that he’d been having another affair alongside the one he’d been having with a Chinese spy, this time with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of health care. It quickly leaked that the Nvidia board was going to sack him, and Huang gave up and quit Thursday morning. This unleashed chaos in the markets. Nvidia stock had plummeted by more than 10 percent after trading opened, though it bounced back somewhat after that. At time of writing, it was down to $160, from its Friday price of $193. That is something like $800 billion in market capitalization gone in the space of a few days. Now we all get to wait on tenterhooks to see if this tawdry scandal touches off an economic crisis, or what huge ramifications come out of Huang’s likely divorce. He has no prenuptial agreement with his wife of 40 years, Lori Huang, and if they divorce, under California’s law that gives her half of the accrued wealth; she will become a mega-billionaire. That money buys a lot of influence. Will it be good or bad? The Prospect in your inbox Analysis that goes beyond the noise with in-depth, progressive reporting. Sign up No paywall, no programmatic ads — just the reporting. Unsubscribe anytime. Submitting your email signs you up for The Daily Prospect, our weekday morning newsletter. Huang is out because, remarkably enough, Nvidia is one of the better-governed tech companies. Unlike Meta, Alphabet (Google’s parent company), Snap, and of course SpaceX, Nvidia does not have a dual-class share structure, in which the company’s founder(s) get total control over the company despite only owning a minority of the shares. As I have previously written , that practice makes a hash of the entire argument for a public corporation and greatly increases the risk of poor business decisions. Neither the board, nor shareholders, nor public pressure could pry Mark Zuckerberg out of the big chair at Meta if he refuses to leave, no matter how many tens of billions of dollars he wastes on some cockamamie metaverse nonsense. But because Huang and his wife only control about 3.6 percent of the company, the Nvidia board and shareholders have real power. When he screwed up badly enough, that was it. That said, Huang had still made himself the center of the business in many ways. He was a quintessential Silicon Valley hero-founder, always wearing his signature leather jacket, and treated like a celebrity around the world. He reportedly had 60 people reporting directly to him, as compared to the traditional five to seven for a CEO. As I wrote regarding Huang’s first reported affair, this mess leaves multiple large question marks hanging over global society. To be clear, I don’t buy the hero-founder myth; without a doubt, somebody at Nvidia or elsewhere could do the job just as well as he could. (Just don’t break the law or screw around on your spouse and you’re halfway there.) That said, the fact that so many people on Wall Street and among retail investors do believe the hero-founder myth could create a self-fulfilling prophecy. And concretely, Huang’s odd management style will mean either the new CEO will have to adapt to a highly unorthodox approach, or conduct a major organizational restructuring, which may disrupt the business. Oligarchs and Chinese Spies: Who’s the Bigger Threat to Americans? What’s more, something I neglected to cover in my first article is that Huang’s first affair may have been part of a straight-up conspiracy to smuggle huge numbers of Nvidia chips into China. His Chinese spy girlfriend Alice Huang ran a company called Megaspeed in Singapore, which some analysts allege is funded by Alibaba, the Chinese retail behemoth. It sure is very odd that Singapore should have suddenly started importing so many Nvidia chips that as of mid-2025, the city-state represented some 22 percent of the company’s total sales—which is roughly the same share that mega-nation China accounted for before export controls came down. After mid-2025, Nvidia simply stopped reporting that figure. Furthermore, investigations have found Megaspeed’s supposed corporate headquarters sit largely empty . Curious! Just as I was finishing this article, The Information reported that Alice Huang had invested in the Chinese AI company DeepSeek, promising them Nvidia chips. So in addition to general chaos and market panic unleashed by this scandal, it may cause a sharp decline in Nvidia’s sales, if not huge legal sanctions for violating American law. (Even Kash Patel’s FBI might be too embarrassed to avoid enforcing the law this time.) That will surely lead it to pull back from its investment in both AI labs and AI data center companies. If so, does that knock down the weaker, heavily indebted ones—like CoreWeave, Oracle, or OpenAI? What knock-on effects might that have on the financial companies that lent the money? That’s how a financial crisis gets rolling. Finally, there is the unfortunate question of Lori Huang. The couple met when they were broke teenage college students and have been married since 1985; they have two kids. If the Huangs get divorced and she gets half of the marital assets, she would instantly become roughly the 30th-richest person in the world , with a fortune in the $60-odd billion range at time of writing. That could turn out largely fine. MacKenzie Scott, Jeff Bezos’s ex-wife, turned out to become the rare mega-billionaire who actually gives money away to people who need it at a rapid clip , instead of to fake charitable foundations run by dim-witted relatives. (Even that, I would argue, is inferior to aid programs conducted by democratic governments.) The Prospect in your inbox Analysis that goes beyond the noise with in-depth, progressive reporting. Sign up No paywall, no programmatic ads — just the reporting. Unsubscribe anytime. Submitting your email signs you up for The Daily Prospect, our weekday morning newsletter. But it could also turn out to be a disaster. When Google co-founder Sergey Brin’s former wife Nicole Shanahan reportedly had a brief affair with Elon Musk (don’t ask me), she got about a billion dollars out of the ensuing divorce settlement in 2023. With that, Shanahan became one of the largest funders of the anti-vaccine movement, then one of the largest funders of Robert Kennedy Jr.’s presidential campaign in 2024, and then eventually his running mate. It is reasonably likely that without this funding—which included shouldering most of a $7 million Super Bowl ad—Kennedy would not be leading the Department of Health and Human Services today. I should emphasize that there is no indication that Lori Huang is a delirious crank. All the accounts I can find report she is a perfectly decent person. My point is that it is a disaster for society for anyone to have this much money, because the downside risk is just too great. Just one billion dollars was enough for one crank to hoist another crank into the most important public-health position in the world, where he slashed funding for cutting-edge medical research , fired world-class scientists en masse , and completely failed to control the worst measles outbreak in more than 30 years. This kind of thing can happen as an incidental consequence of apparently rampant cheating among the billionaire class—even with a prenuptial agreement; Shanahan got less than 1 percent of Brin’s fortune. Hyper-concentration of markets means that one man’s sexual indiscretions can become an entire planet’s economic problem. The concomitant hyper-concentration of wealth means that the ensuing divorce court details can have world-historic implications. Pennsylvania babies should not be dying because of some random oligarch affair, and if we taxed billionaire fortunes out of existence, they wouldn’t be. The post This Is the Problem With Oligarchy Right Here appeared first on The American Prospect .

（中央社記者李雅雯上海13日電）中國國防部新聞發言人陳曦今天表示，中美兩國防務部門保持溝通協調，妥善管控分歧。對於美國戰爭部長赫格塞斯、美國太平洋司令部司令帕帕羅可能訪問中國的消息未加以回應。
據央視新聞13日報導，記者提問中美兩軍近期多次互動，還有赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）、帕帕羅（Samuel Paparo）近期可能訪問中國的消息，「請介紹中美兩軍交往有關情況」。
陳曦回應，中美兩軍於11月2至3日在華盛頓舉行第4次危機溝通與預防工作組會議，雙方對於落實兩國元首共識、加強溝通交流、避免誤解誤判等深入交換意見。中美兩軍保持關係穩定、健康、可持續發展符合雙方共同利益，也是國際社會的普遍期待。
他說，中方重視中美兩軍戰略溝通，兩國防務部門就各層級交流對話保持著溝通協調。希望美方與中方一道，共同落實好兩國元首重要共識，加強溝通對話，妥善管控分歧，為構建中美建設性戰略穩定關係增添積極因素。
陳曦對於赫格塞斯、帕帕羅近期可能訪問中國的消息未加以證實與回應。
南華早報先前報導，美中關係全國委員會會長歐倫斯（Stephen Orlins）6日在中國海南三亞舉行的全球海洋合作與治理論壇上透過視訊談話透露，赫格塞斯、帕帕羅可能很快會訪問中國。歐倫斯認為，兩人訪中將有助於推動兩軍溝通機制常態化。
帕帕羅倘若訪中，將是美國太平洋司令部司令自2015年以來首次訪中。在美國共和黨期中選舉失利後，相關安排是否有所改變尚不清楚。（編輯：廖文綺）1151113

content:
美国空军研究实验室与空战司令部近日在内华达靶场对XQ-67A无人自主协同平台(ACP)进行飞行试验。XQ-67A在飞行过程中展示多种先进任务系统的集成能力，在面对未来作战的自主能力方面，取得重要的技术里程碑。美国空军“协同作战飞机”CCA项目入选的两架无人机之一、美国通用原子公司的FQ-42A“复仇”(Vengeance)无人机，即是由XQ-67A发展而来。
在飞行过程中，XQ-67A展示了多种先进任务系统的集成能力，包括尖端传感器、任务计算机，以及动力与热管理硬件。
此外，还集成了“超视距”数据链，并运用了实兵、虚拟与构造(LVC)仿真技术进行训练，展示了在分布式战区内对无人平台进行管理的能力，进一步增强了威慑力。
这是美国空军研究实验室(AFRL)与空战司令部(ACC)的试验作战部队近日在内华达试验与训练靶场对XQ-67A进行的实验。
XQ-67A属于“低成本可消耗飞行器平台共享”计划（Low Cost Attritable Aircraft Platform）简称LCAAPS。
LCAAPS的核心理念与汽车制造业一样，通过共用底盘、动力传动系统和发动机，来制造不同车型，从而在降低成本的同时，维持生产供应链的稳定。
基于XQ-67A平台发展而来的，就是美国通用原子公司(General Atomics)入选美国空军“协同作战飞机”CCA项目的FQ-42A “复仇”（Vengeance）无人机。
此次飞行试验是在“自主协同平台性能与效能演示”（Demon APE）项目框架下完成的，通过加速自主协同平台(ACP)的开发与交付，直接支持美国空军部在《国防战略》中所设定的优先事项。
该项目特别侧重于寻求战场态势感知解决方案，并利用专门用于侦察任务的自主协同平台来实现这一目标。其最终目标是将这些平台与战斗机、轰炸机等有人驾驶航空器进行无缝集成，从而对敌方构成更具杀伤力的挑战。
在FQ-42A “复仇”（Vengeance）无人机之外，另一款入选美国空军“协同作战飞机”CCA项目的是美国安杜里尔公司的(Anduril)FQ-44A“狂怒”（Fury）无人机。

title: OpenAI launches security products, tells orgs they’re doomed if they don’t use them
zh_title: OpenAI 推出安全产品，告诉组织如果不使用这些产品就注定失败

content:
OpenAI 推出了两种新的安全产品，一种用于渗透测试，另一种用于防御，并警告组织只有使用此类工具，他们的业务才是安全的。 OpenAI 总裁格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman) 在周四的主题演讲中表示：“我们现在所处的阶段是，公司的安全取决于他们用来保护自己的前沿模型以及他们利用该模型的程度。”破坏安全性的公司的联合创始人确实承认，安全性“基础知识很重要，不容忽视”。然而，“你需要真正围绕这些模型的功能重新调整你的安全实践，”布罗克曼零讽刺地说道，并且大概谈论的是使用人工智能模型进行防御，而不是攻击其他组织。 “产品也很重要。”当然，这个产品应该来自 OpenAI，为此，该公司推出了 Daybreak Red Team 和 Daybreak Defense Factory，它们都是 OpenAI Daybreak 安全平台的一部分。 Red Team 现已推出抢先体验版，它使用 OpenAI 模型来测试公司的 Web 应用程序是否存在漏洞。网络应用人工智能的领导者 Nancy Wang 将其描述为“自动连续扫描规模的超人笔测试”，一组代理使用源代码和应用程​​序上下文来调查和测试攻击路径。
它还帮助安全团队验证报告的漏洞（来自代码扫描器、错误赏金计划和披露报告），然后测试这些缺陷的补丁。第二个产品 Daybreak Defense Factory 通过“大规模查找、验证和修复漏洞”来自动化“防御循环”。该模型还使用基于 OpenAI 最新网络模型构建的代理 - 目前为 GPT-6 Cyber​​ 。这些代理扫描组织的代码库，寻找漏洞并开发补丁。工程师在投入生产之前审查并批准建议的修复方案。 “通过这种方式，工程师可以获得带有补丁的合并就绪拉取请求，并进行测试以证明其有效，”王说。与此同时，正当 OpenAI 高管宣传新的安全产品时，一个非营利组织联盟向旧金山高等法院提起诉讼，要求法官阻止 OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌、Meta 和 SpaceX 的人工智能业务开发或部署比其最先进的现有模型更强大的人工智能系统。该诉讼由 Irreplaceable Education Fund、Public Citizen、Heat Initiative 和 The Alliance for Secure AI 提起，列举了 OpenAI 代理访问 Hugging Face、未经授权访问包含医疗保险统计数据的澳大利亚政府门户网站以及其他与人工智能相关的网络安全事件的事件。
法庭文件称，“被告告诉我们，他们正在开发的人工智能技术给公众带来了灾难性风险，包括引发人工智能驱动的网络攻击和生物武器”，并补充说人工智能公司“并没有错”。 ®

【原文 English Original】
OpenAI has launched two new security products, one for penetration testing and another for defense, and warned organizations that their businesses are only safe if they use tools like these. “We're now at a point where companies will be secure only to the extent of the frontier model that they use to defend themselves and how well they utilize that,” OpenAI President Greg Brockman said during a Thursday keynote address. The co-founder of the company that broke security did admit that security “fundamentals are important, and not to be discounted.” However, “you need to really reorient your security practice around what these models can do,” Brockman said, with zero irony, and presumably talking about using AI models for defense - not for hacking other organizations . “Also very important is product.” This product, of course, should come from OpenAI, and, to that end, the company rolled out Daybreak Red Team and Daybreak Defense Factory, which are both part of OpenAI’s Daybreak security platform. Red Team , which is available in early access, uses OpenAI models to test companies’ web applications for vulnerabilities. Nancy Wang, who leads cyber-applied AI, described it as “superhuman pen-test at the scale of automated continuous scanning,” with a fleet of agents using source code and app context to investigate and test attack paths. It also helps security teams validate reported vulnerabilities - from code scanners, bug bounty programs, and disclosure reports - and then test the patches for these flaws. The second product, Daybreak Defense Factory , automates the “defensive loop” by “finding, validating, and fixing vulnerabilities at scale.” This one also uses agents built on OpenAI’s latest cyber models - currently, that’s GPT-6 Cyber . The agents scan organizations’ codebases, hunting for vulnerabilities and developing patches. Engineers review and approve the proposed fixes before they go into production. “This way engineers get a merge-ready pull request with the patch and a test that shows that it works,” Wang said. Meanwhile, as OpenAI execs touted the new security products, a coalition of nonprofits filed a lawsuit in San Francisco Superior Court asking a judge to stop OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and SpaceX's AI businesses from developing or deploying AI systems more capable than their most advanced existing models. The lawsuit , filed by Irreplaceable Education Fund, Public Citizen, Heat Initiative, and The Alliance for Secure AI, cites incidents involving OpenAI agents accessing Hugging Face , gaining unauthorized access to an Australian government portal containing Medicare statistics , and other AI-related cybersecurity incidents . “Defendants tell us that the AI technology they are developing poses catastrophic risks to the public, including by enabling AI-driven cyberattacks and bioweapons,” the court documents allege, adding that the AI companies “are not wrong.” ®

title: Jensen Huang's self-sabotage sends Nvidia into a midlife crisis
zh_title: 黄仁勋的自我破坏让英伟达陷入中年危机
summary: 英伟达首席执行官兼创始人黄仁勋在经历了近两周的争议后被赶下台，这些争议有时感觉更像是肥皂剧而不是现实：一个富商、报道的绯闻以及一名涉嫌中国间谍和 GPU 走私者。对于英伟达董事会来说，黄仁勋的离开似乎是毫无疑问的。事实证明，这位最近成为世界上最有价值公司的幕后黑手承担了太大的责任，无法以任何身份保留。即使从首席执行官降职为董事长，他也太有毒了，即使他不再被信任，这一有利地位仍能让黄作为公司的代言人。
content:
英伟达首席执行官兼创始人黄仁勋在经历了近两周的争议后被赶下台，这些争议有时感觉更像是肥皂剧而不是现实：一个富商、报道的绯闻以及一名涉嫌中国间谍和 GPU 走私者。对于英伟达董事会来说，黄仁勋的离开似乎是毫无疑问的。事实证明，这位最近成为世界上最有价值公司的幕后黑手承担了太大的责任，无法以任何身份保留。即使从首席执行官降职为董事长，他也太有毒了，即使不再信任他来管理公司，这一有利地位仍将使黄作为公司的代言人。取代他不会那么容易。英伟达现在面临着身份危机。黄先生领导该公司三十多年，目前还没有明确的继任者。 GPU 投手不乏才华横溢的工程师，但能够与世界上最大、最有影响力的品牌之一争吵的高管则不然。 CUDA 之父、Nvidia 超大规模和 HPC 副总裁伊恩·巴克 (Ian Buck) 目前被许多人视为黄仁勋的继任者。近年来，巴克在英伟达内部扮演了更加公开的角色，在超级计算和人工智能基础设施峰会等活动上发表主题演讲。首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 是一名精打细算的人，十多年来一直坚持詹森的雄心壮志，现在，在董事会寻找下一任傀儡领导人时，她现在担任临时首席执行官。
尽管克雷斯努力遏制混乱，但其他人无疑会利用黄氏有争议的配偶选择来推进自己的议程。 声誉受损 人们只需要问几个不方便的问题就可以对英伟达的忠诚度产生怀疑。中国对英伟达的影响力有多深？ Nvidia的硬件还可以信任吗？你明白了。这当然不是英伟达以及黄仁勋的忠诚第一次受到质疑。 2023 年末，Cerebras 首席执行官安德鲁·费尔德曼 (Andrew Feldman) 抨击竞争对手英伟达不顾美国出口管制向中国供应 GPU，称这种行为“不美国”，并将这家图形巨头比作人工智能军火商。英伟达还面临美国政府官员的批评，其中包括前商务部长吉娜·雷蒙多(Gina Raimondo)，称其没有接受暗示，而是试图在美国出口管制下陷入困境，以继续向中国出售芯片。去年年初，特朗普政府短暂封锁 H20 销售，使该公司损失了约 105 亿美元，此后，黄仁勋在 2025 年的大部分时间里游说特朗普政府撤销对中国销售老一代 Hopper 一代 GPU 的出口禁令，这一努力最终证明是成功的。有人可能会认为，黄仁勋不断向中国出售英伟达芯片的努力是出于经济动机。
但黄承认与 Megaspeed 执行官 Alice Huang（无亲属关系）有婚外情，这一论点被削弱了。美国情报部门指控她兼职担任中国间谍，并帮助将 GPU 走私到中国。 争议的后果 当技术和政治发生冲突时，不当行为的表象往往比不当行为本身更可怕。山姆大叔迫使中国公司撤离美国，仅仅是因为它们可能被迫在关键基础设施中安装后门。只要问问华为，一旦华盛顿认定你对国家安全构成威胁，真相是否还重要。黄的事件可能不仅让他失去工作，还可能让英伟达失去关键

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia CEO and founder Jensen Huang has been ousted after nearly two weeks of controversy that, at times, felt more like a soap opera than reality: a wealthy businessman, reported affairs, and an alleged Chinese spy and GPU smuggler. For Nvidia’s board, it seems there was no question Huang had to go. The man behind what was recently the most valuable company in the world proved too big a liability to retain in any capacity. He was too toxic even for a demotion from CEO to chairman, a vantage point that would have retained Huang as the face of the company even if he could no longer be trusted to run it. Replacing him won’t be so easy. Nvidia now faces an identity crisis. Huang, who has led the company for more than three decades, has no clear successor. The GPU slinger has no shortage of brilliant engineers, but executives capable of wrangling one of the biggest and most influential brands in the world, not so much. Ian Buck, father of CUDA and Nvidia’s VP of hyperscale and HPC is currently favored by many to be Huang’s successor. Buck has taken on a more public role within Nvidia in recent years headlining keynotes at events like Supercomputing and the AI Infra Summit. CFO Colette Kress, a bean counter who’s kept Jensen’s ambitions grounded for more than a decade, now takes the reins as interim CEO while the board searches for its next figurehead. And while Kress fights to contain the chaos, others will no doubt capitalize on Huang’s controversial choice of consorts to advance their own agendas. A marred reputation One need only ask a few inconvenient questions to cast doubt on Nvidia’s loyalties. How deep does China’s influence in Nvidia go? Can Nvidia’s hardware still be trusted? You get the idea. It certainly wouldn’t be the first time Nvidia’s and, by extension, Huang’s loyalties have been called into question. In late 2023, Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman blasted rival Nvidia for supplying GPUs to China in spite of US export controls, calling the behavior “ un-American ” and likening the graphics titan to an AI arms dealer. Nvidia has also faced criticism from US government officials, including former commerce secretary Gina Raimondo, for failing to take a hint and trying instead to limbo under US export controls in order to continue selling chips to the Middle Kingdom. After the Trump administration's short lived blockade of H20 sales early last year cost the company some $10.5 billion, Huang spent much of the 2025 lobbying the Trump administration to reverse export bans on the sales of older Hopper generation GPUs to China, an endeavor which ultimately proved successful . One could make the case that Huang’s ongoing efforts to sell Nvidia’s chips to China were financially motivated. But that argument is undermined by Huang admitting to having an extramarital affair with Megaspeed exec Alice Huang (no relation), a woman that US intelligence has accused of moonlighting as a Chinese spy and helping to smuggle GPUs into the country. The consequences of controversy When technology and politics collide, the appearance of impropriety is often more damning than the impropriety itself. Uncle Sam has forced Chinese companies out of the United States for the mere possibility that they could be coerced into planting back doors in critical infrastructure. Just ask Huawei whether the truth counts for anything once Washington has decided that you’re a national security threat. Huang’s affairs may not just cost him his job, but could cost Nvidia key government contracts and make the company’s hardware less attractive, particularly in highly-regulated and notoriously risk-averse industries. Rival chipmakers will no doubt capitalize on Nvidia’s bad optics if Huang’s departure doesn’t pop the AI financing merry-go-round bubble first – Nvidia's stock lost about 25% of its value in the few days after news about Huang started breaking, only recovering slightly after his ouster. Regardless, with Nvidia’s reputation marred and its future shrouded in uncertainty, once loyal customers may be more willing to explore alternative providers. There are certainly plenty to choose from. Amid a surge in custom AI chips from the likes of Broadcom, Marvel, and others, Nvidia’s main advantage wasn’t so much technological as it was simply considered a safe bet. AMD is the most obvious winner here. As we reported earlier this year , the House of Zen’s GPU tech has already surpassed Nvidia’s, at least on paper. What’s more, the company has a long and unblemished relationship serving the US government. AMD’s chips now power two of the Department of Energy’s three largest and most sensitive supercomputers. Meanwhile, hyperscalers with sufficient cashflow – think Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta – may seek to insulate themselves from Huang’s fallout by investing more heavily in homegrown silicon and offering it to customers. Then there's the threat from the man himself. Huang's ambitions and influence are such that he's unlikely to fade into obscurity. He may disappear from the spotlight while things blow over, but it’s a pretty sure bet that he’ll pop up at a new company eventually, and will still have enough sway to poach some of Nvidia’s top engineers. ®

title: AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program
zh_title: AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系
summary: AIT 与 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系 PR-2631 2026 年 11 月 11 日 AIT 与 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系 2026 年 11 月 10 日，美国在台协会 (AIT) 华盛顿常务董事 Ingrid Larson 与台北驻美国经济文化代表处 (TECRO) 代表 Alexander Tah-Ray Yui 签署了一份建立台湾奖学金计划（TFP）的谅解备忘录（MOU）。 《台湾联谊法》获得国会通过并签署成为法律
content:
AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美国与台湾的伙伴关系 PR-2631 2026 年 11 月 11 日 AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美国与台湾的伙伴关系 2026 年 11 月 10 日，美国在台协会 (AIT) 华盛顿董事总经理 Ingrid Larson 和台北驻美国经济文化代表处 (TECRO) 代表 Alexander Tah-Ray Yui 签署了一份建立台湾奖学金计划（TFP）的谅解备忘录（MOU）。 《台湾奖学金法案》在两党广泛支持下获得国会通过并签署成为法律。今天，AIT 和 TECRO 签署了谅解备忘录，并与国务院教育和文化事务局协调，启动了该计划的实施。该计划的主要目标是扩大和加强美台伙伴关系，并加强美国官员在台湾和海峡两岸问题上的专业知识。 TFP 将在台湾各地建立一批具有语言技能、文化知识和持久工作关系的联邦专业人士。根据该奖学金计划，美国联邦雇员将花费长达一年的时间进行强化普通话培训和地区研究。培训完成后，研究员预计将在台湾议会办公室、部委、其他机构或办公室或台湾公共部门以外的组织工作最长一年。
国会议员以及美国国务院、TECRO 和 AIT 的代表出席了在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿举行的签字仪式，与会者称赞该计划在加强美台伙伴关系和建立美国政府在台湾问题上的专业知识方面所发挥的作用。美国在台协会董事总经理英格丽·拉尔森 (Ingrid Larson) 表示：“TFP 反映了两党对美台关系的大力支持以及对以民间关系为核心的共同承诺。” 《AIT 和 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系》一文首先发表在美国在台协会上。

【原文 English Original】
AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program PR-2631 November 11, 2026 AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program   On November 10, 2026, American Institute in Taiwan (AIT) Washington Managing Director Ingrid Larson and the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States (TECRO) Representative Alexander Tah-Ray Yui signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to establish the Taiwan Fellowship Program (TFP).   The Taiwan Fellowship Act was passed by Congress and signed into law with broad bipartisan support. Today’s signing of the MOU between AIT and TECRO initiates the program’s implementation, in coordination with the Department of State’s Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs. The main objectives of the Program are to expand and strengthen the U.S.-Taiwan partnership, as well as strengthen U.S. officials’ expertise regarding Taiwan and cross-Strait issues. TFP will build a group of federal professionals with language skills, cultural knowledge, and lasting working relationships across Taiwan.   Under the fellowship program, U.S. federal employees will spend up to one year in intensive Mandarin language training and area studies. Upon completion of training, the Fellows are expected to work, for up to one year, in Taiwan parliamentary offices, ministries, other agencies or offices, or organizations outside the public sector in Taiwan.   Members of Congress and representatives from the U.S. Department of State, TECRO, and AIT attended the signing ceremony in Arlington, Virginia, where attendees praised the program’s role in strengthening the U.S.-Taiwan partnership and building U.S. government expertise on Taiwan.   “TFP reflects strong bipartisan support for the U.S.-Taiwan relationship and a shared commitment to the people-to-people ties at its core,” said AIT Managing Director Ingrid Larson. content:
Victory Metals (ASX: VTM) 与澳大利亚珀斯的科廷大学合作，以中试规模将重稀土精矿加工成混合稀土碳酸盐 (MREC)，推进其在澳大利亚的下游加工计划。根据材料转让协议，Victory 的波斯伍德工厂生产的精矿将在该大学的阴极前体生产试验工厂 (C4P) 进行加工。该设施的开发是为了支持澳大利亚的电池和关键矿产行业，投资额超过 1840 万澳元（1260 万美元）。 Victory 执行董事兼首席执行官布伦丹·克拉克 (Brendan Clark) 表示：“确保进入 C4P 设施是 Victory Metals 的一项重大发展，也是我们建立澳大利亚综合重稀土供应链的雄心。” “这尤其重要，因为我们可以利用澳大利亚现有的加工基础设施和专业知识，而不必独立开发下游加工途径的每个阶段。”根据该计划生产的 MREC 样品预计将返回 Victory 与国际承购和炼油合作伙伴一起进行技术评估和评估。该协议有效期至 2027 年。试点工作还旨在测试澳大利亚 Victory 北斯坦莫尔稀土项目精矿加工路线。周三，Victory 股价在悉尼收于每股 1.24 澳元，上涨 0.4%。
中国的限制 此次合作正值澳大利亚和美国努力限制中国对关键矿产的投资。5月，澳大利亚政府以国家安全为由，命令中国投资者出售北方矿业公司（ASX：NTU）的稀土股份。 11月9日，中国宣布进一步暂停部分出口管制措施至2027年1月10日，其中包括与中重稀土产品有关的措施。克拉克补充道：“胜利公司正在将自己定位为在发展澳大利亚国内重稀土供应链方面发挥重要作用。”由于中国控制着世界约 60% 的稀土矿产量和几乎所有矿物加工能力，许多政府都在寻找确保自身生产安全的方法。 Victory表示，澳大利亚MREC加工中心的建立与美国、欧洲、日本、印度、韩国和越南的客户相关。

【原文 English Original】
Victory Metals (ASX: VTM) has partnered with Curtin University in Perth, Australia, to process heavy rare earth concentrate into mixed rare earth carbonate (MREC) at pilot scale, advancing its plans for downstream processing in Australia. Under the material transfer agreement, concentrate produced at Victory’s Burswood plant will be processed at the university’s Cathode Precursor Production Pilot Plant (C4P). The facility was developed to support Australia’s battery and critical minerals industry and represents more than A$18.4 million ($12.6 million) in investment. “Securing access to the C4P facility is a significant development for Victory Metals and our ambition to establish an integrated Australian heavy rare earth supply chain,” said Brendan Clark, Victory’s executive director and CEO. “This is particularly important because we can leverage established Australian processing infrastructure and expertise rather than having to develop every stage of the downstream processing pathway independently.” MREC samples produced under the program are expected to be returned to Victory for technical assessment and evaluation alongside international offtake and refining partners. The agreement runs through 2027.  The pilot work is also intended to test an Australian processing route for concentrate from Victory’s North Stanmore rare earth project. Victory’s shares closed at A$1.24 apiece, up 0.4%, Wednesday in Sydney.  Chinese restrictions The partnership comes as Australia and the UShave made efforts to limit Chinese investment in critical minerals. In May , the Australian government ordered Chinese investors to sell rare earth stakes in Northern Minerals (ASX: NTU), citing national security concerns. On Nov. 9, China announced a further suspension of certain export-control measures until Jan. 10, 2027. These include measures relating to medium and heavy rare-earth products. “Victory is positioning itself to play an important role in developing Australia’s domestic heavy rare earth supply chain,” Clark added.  With China controlling about 60% of the world’s mined rare earth output and nearly all of the minerals’ processing capacity, many governments have looked for ways to secure their own production. Victory says the establishment of Australian MREC processing is relevant to customers in the U.S., Europe, Japan, India, South Korea and Vietnam.

content:
Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology
This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth
Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser.
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.
<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>
We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.
All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.
Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.
There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.
To sum up, the issues were:
No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature
So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.
<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>
"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience.
By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."
We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.
Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.
Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:
"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."
Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>
Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.
Supporting the editors - all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
Supporting our contributors - we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
Recruiting more people - paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
Enhance our level of expertise - we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
Expand our network - we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.
<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>
Munawwar Abdulla is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.
Sonya Imin is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.
Maidina Kadeer is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

content:
中国大陆解放军本月初在未事先公布的情况下，在台湾周边及西太平洋举行大规模军演。台湾官员称，这是北京在重大国际会议前，对台湾及其他政府施压的“无声威吓”行动。图为台北101建筑。 （路透社）
中国大陆解放军本月初在未事先公布的情况下，在台湾周边及西太平洋举行大规模军演。台湾官员称，这是北京在重大国际会议前，对台湾及其他政府施压的“无声威吓”行动。
路透社引述一名要求匿名的台湾安全高层说，解放军海军及中国大陆海警本月初一度有超过100艘舰艇在西太平洋活动，演练内容包括模拟攻击台湾等地的军队和城市，部署规模超过去年底的“正义使命—2025”围台军演。
中国大陆下周将在深圳主办亚太经合组织（APEC）领袖峰会，预计美国总统特朗普与中国大陆国家主席习近平届时将举行今年第三次会晤。台湾也是APEC成员。
上述官员说，在最新一轮军演期间，一艘解放军潜艇还从黄海向大陆境内发射了一枚洲际弹道导弹。“这是一场无声的演习，实际上也是无声的威吓。”
他说：“这就像劫匪把枪藏在外套口袋里，枪口对着银行柜员，吓得柜员交出钱来，同时又避免触发警报，引来大批警察。”
官员指出，此次军演涉及东部、北部和南部战区的海军协同行动。从规模来看，解放军似乎不仅在演练封锁台湾，也在演练覆盖西太平洋的更广泛行动，并尝试将各区域舰队整合为一支统一的远海作战力量。
不过，两名台湾安全官员说，大陆海军本周已缩减部署规模，星期五（11月13日）约有70艘舰船在第一岛链内活动。
台湾国安会秘书长吴钊燮星期四（11月12日）在社交平台X发文说，虽然舰船数量有所减少，但北部、东部和南部战区编队，以及辽宁舰航母打击群，仍在菲律宾以东海域活动，解放军空军在台湾附近的活动也依然频繁。
一名外国情报消息人士认为，北京刻意不公布这场“没有名称的无声军演”，意在施加军事压力的同时，避免引发外交反弹。他也指出，年末天气通常较为平稳，也是中国大陆惯常举行军演的时期。

（中央社記者葉素萍台北13日電）中國日前在北京舉行孫中山誕辰紀念活動，台獨聯盟與台灣安保協會今天表示，北京藉孫中山來強調「一個中國」，將台灣社會對孫中山的歷史象徵嫁接至北京的一中認同，呼籲台灣逐步揚棄孫中山相關象徵，避免成為中國對台認知作戰的破口。
台獨聯盟與台灣安保協會今天發布聲明指出，北京於12日紀念孫中山，並非紀念中華民國國父，而是利用孫中山強調一個中國。孫中山主張的民權與憲政，在中共一黨專政下，紀念活動已淪為徒具形式。
聲明指出，中國慣用的手法，是將台灣社會殘存對中華民國國父的象徵，嫁接到對北京的一中認同。當台灣政府拒絕讓人民赴中國配合統戰式紀念活動，北京便指稱台灣背叛歷史；當台灣仍有人紀念孫中山，北京則誇飾為「兩岸同根」。
台灣安保協會認為，台灣應逐步放棄孫中山相關象徵，因為孫中山與台灣民主化歷程無關，且一直是國民黨的黨國符碼。這個被移植到台灣的虛構政治象徵應該揚棄，而非陷入誰才是孫中山正統繼承者的詮釋爭奪。
聲明強調，任何制度化存在的孫中山象徵，包括錢幣、建築物及路名等，都可能成為中華人民共和國倡議一個中國的破口。中華人民共和國從未統治台灣，即使是荷蘭、日本等曾經統治台灣的政權，也不能憑藉歷史事實擅自決定當代台灣人的未來，台灣前途應由台灣人民自己決定。
台灣安保協會也質疑，面對北京利用孫中山推動祖國統一的民族主義論述，陸委會以中華民國對抗中華人民共和國，強調中華民國國祚未斷、兩國互不隸屬，但這樣的策略存在問題。
聲明指出，「台灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例」仍處於台灣地區與大陸地區的一中框架，在此框架下強化中華民國正統論述，等於與北京爭奪誰才是孫中山繼承者，反而可能弱化或模糊台灣認同。
台灣安保協會強調，台灣認同是形成敵我意識不可或缺的要素，而敵我意識也是抵抗意志的前提。面對中國一中意識形態的認知作戰，唯有鞏固台灣認同，才能對中國認知作戰產生免疫力。（編輯：林克倫）1151113

（中央社台北13日電）中國外交部發言人今天宣布，亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）第三十三次領導人非正式會議將於18日至19日在深圳舉行，中國國家主席習近平將主持會議並發表講話，還將與各國領導人舉行雙邊會晤。
據中國外交部官網，APEC第三十三次領導人非正式會議主題為「建設亞太共同體，促進共同繁榮」，習近平將主持會議並發表講話。
APEC工商領導人峰會將於17日至18日在深圳舉行，會議主題為「共促繁榮，共贏未來」，習近平將出席開幕式並作主旨演講。
中國外交部表示，會議期間，習近平還將為與會各經濟體領導人或代表舉行歡迎宴會，並與各國領導人舉行雙邊會晤。
外界關注在APEC會議期間，美中俄元首是否會舉行三方會談。美國總統川普日前表示，他認為自己下週在APEC領袖峰會上，將與習近平和俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）會面，討論結束伊朗戰爭及非核化等議題。
日本共同社日前引述多名消息人士指出，中國政府仍對日本首相高市早苗2025年11月在國會答詢時發表的涉台言論（「台灣有事」說）持強硬立場，拒絕她與習近平舉行正式會談，使雙方難以就領袖會談取得共識。（編輯：陳鎧妤/陳承功）1151113

title: 黄仁勋曾告诉我，那些关于中国与国家安全的问题
summary: BBC经济编辑 费萨尔·伊斯兰（Faisal Islam） Nvidia（辉达／英伟达）行政总裁黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）身上，有一种已故苹果公司创办人乔布斯（Steve Jobs）的气质。我曾分别访问两人，他们都有一种近距离接触时令人难以忽视的个人魅力，以及偶尔流露出带点锋芒的天才特质。 两人都有标志性的黑色衣着打扮，不过黄仁勋选择穿皮褛，而非乔布斯那件经典的樽领毛衣。 两人都是科技界备受推崇的创新者。不过，黄仁勋如今正因涉嫌与一名被指是中国间谍的人士有婚外情受到调
content: BBC经济编辑 费萨尔·伊斯兰（Faisal Islam） Nvidia（辉达／英伟达）行政总裁黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）身上，有一种已故苹果公司创办人乔布斯（Steve Jobs）的气质。我曾分别访问两人，他们都有一种近距离接触时令人难以忽视的个人魅力，以及偶尔流露出带点锋芒的天才特质。 两人都有标志性的黑色衣着打扮，不过黄仁勋选择穿皮褛，而非乔布斯那件经典的樽领毛衣。 两人都是科技界备受推崇的创新者。不过，黄仁勋如今正因涉嫌与一名被指是中国间谍的人士有婚外情受到调查。 过去几个月，你听到有关人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI；人工智慧）的所有消息，无论是正面、负面、革命性突破，还是灾难性后果，都取决于能否取得最强大的前沿人工智能模型。 而这些模型又有赖最强大的微晶片。多年来，这个领域一直由黄仁勋领导的 Nvidia 主导。公司的技术源自重新改良的游戏图像处理技术，并结合台湾强大的晶片制造实力。 Gracehopper、Vera 和 Rubin 等名称，对一般大众而言几乎毫无意义，但它们其实都是晶片的名称，支援着人工智能模型的开发，而这些模型正改变世界。 去年9月，美国总统特朗普（Donald Trump；川普）访问英国期间，我曾与黄仁勋会面。当时他正与记者交谈，并鼓励英国继续发展科技产业。 那次会面也正值他努力游说特朗普解除对华出口限制，让英伟达可以向中国出售部分性能最强大的人工智能晶片，尤其是H200晶片。 当时，美国已经解除对一款性能较低晶片的出口禁令。我向黄仁勋指出，他是少数能够走进白宫与特朗普会面，几天后又能在北京与中国国家主席习近平会面的其中一人。 他毫不掩饰自己的立场，也不避讳表示自己认为已成功说服特朗普接受他的理据。 他说：“特朗普总统的立场非常清楚。他希望美国取得胜利，而习近平主席也希望中国取得胜利，两者其实可以同时实现。原因是这并不是一场零和游戏。人类社会的进步，并不是一场零和游戏。” 他大概是世界上唯一能够如此有底气地说出这番话的人，因为他可能曾亲耳听过这两个超级大国领袖表达各自的想法。 对安全风险的不同看法 然而，黄仁勋所说的“零和游戏”观点，并不获许多国家安全领域的人士认同。 他们认为，争夺最先进人工智能技术的竞赛完全是一场零和游戏，西方国家、尤其是美国，必须采取关键行动，阻止中国取得技术优势。 他们认为，哪个国家能够利用最强大的晶片，开发出最强大的人工智能系统，便会在科学发展、破解加密技术、经济增长，以及网络武器等领域取得胜利。 黄仁勋则提出另一种看法：这不但不是国家安全挑战，反而让全世界、包括中国，都依赖美国的系统，对美国更有利。这些系统被称为“美国科技堆叠”（American tech stack），而英伟达的晶片正是其中的核心。 黄仁勋更进一步表示，特朗普总统“非常清楚地看待”一个观点：这类运算技术“并非国家安全问题”。 他告诉我：“任何军队都足够聪明，知道应该以自己的本土技术建立军事系统，而不是依赖对手来建造自己的技术和军事能力。” 这反映了甚么？ 当时，也就是如今黄仁勋因国家安全疑虑及涉嫌中国间谍活动而接受独立调查的同一时期，他公开提出解除对华出口禁令的理据，而且似乎相当清楚特朗普总统的立场。 不止如此，他当时也反驳了另一种说法：中国取得英伟达的技术会构成任何形式的国家安全威胁。 英伟达正处于美国人工智能科技热潮，以及全球争夺人工智能主导地位的竞赛核心。 即使这场热潮最终演变成泡沫爆破，英伟达预料仍会保持强劲的财务状况。 公司今年的实际收入约达4,000亿美元（2.88万亿元人民币；12兆元新台币）。星期一（11月9日）股价下跌约4%，反映科技与全球政治交汇之际出现了新的重大风险，但这家晶片制造商的市值仍然超过4万亿美元。 本文原以英文撰写，我们使用了人工智能协助翻译，并由BBC记者在发布前进行审核。了解更多关于我们如何使用人工智能的资讯。

content:
香港报告输入性猴痘病例，男子在国外有高风险接触 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 13 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港报告输入性猴痘病例 男子在海外有高风险接触
香港卫生防护中心正在调查一宗输入性猴痘病例，涉及一名34岁男子，他上周出现症状，目前在医院情况稳定。患者自称在潜伏期内在香港以外地区与其他男性发生高风险性接触
香港卫生防护中心（CHP）11月13日表示，正在调查一起涉及一名34岁男子的输入性猴痘病例。患者上周出现发烧、疲劳和手臂皮疹，随后皮疹扩散到身体的其他部位。周三，他到伊丽莎白女王医院急症室寻求治疗，并入院接受隔离治疗。目前他的病情稳定。
卫生防护中心表示，经其公共卫生化验服务部门检测的临床样本证实，该患者的猴痘病毒呈阳性。根据病人提供的资料，他在潜伏期内在香港境外期间与其他男子发生高风险性接触。卫生防护中心正继续就个案进行流行病学调查，并会向世界卫生组织报告。
卫生防护中心建议高危目标人群接种猴痘疫苗。它还敦促公众保持警惕，避免与疑似感染猴痘的人进行密切身体接触。

Hong Kong reports imported monkeypox case, man had high-risk contact abroad | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 13 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong reports imported monkeypox case, man had high-risk contact abroad
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection is investigating an imported monkeypox case involving a 34-year-old man who developed symptoms last week and is now in stable condition in hospital. The patient reported high-risk sexual contact with other men during the incubation period while outside Hong K
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection (CHP) said on 13 November it is investigating an imported case of monkeypox involving a 34-year-old man. The patient developed a fever, fatigue and a rash on his arm last week, with the rash later spreading to other parts of his body. He sought treatment at Queen Elizabeth Hospital's accident and emergency department on Wednesday and was admitted for isolation treatment. His condition is now stable.
The CHP said clinical samples tested by its Public Health Laboratory Services branch confirmed the patient was positive for the monkeypox virus. According to information provided by the patient, he had high-risk sexual contact with other men during the incubation period while outside Hong Kong. The CHP is continuing its epidemiological investigation into the case and will report it to the World Health Organization.
The CHP advised members of high-risk target groups to receive the monkeypox vaccine. It also urged the public to remain vigilant and avoid close physical contact with people suspected of being infected with monkeypox.

title: 黄仁勋辞职风波发酵 美议员促收紧对华晶片出口管制
